title: Sales Lead Management & Coordination Executive
description:
**1. Role Overview**

Hydromo is looking for a proactive, highly organised and result-oriented Sales Lead Management & Coordination Executive to manage inbound enquiries, qualify prospects, coordinate with the sales team and drive effective lead progression towards business conversion.

The individual will serve as the first point of contact for prospective customers generated through multiple channels, ensuring timely communication, systematic lead qualification, consistent followups and seamless coordination between customers and the sales team.

The role requires excellent communication skills, strong follow-up discipline, data management capabilities and the ability to prioritise opportunities to improve sales productivity and conversion timelines.

**2. Key Responsibilities**

**A. Inbound Lead Management & Qualification**

* Handle daily inbound leads generated through digital campaigns, website enquiries, referrals, social media and other sources.
* Make initial calls to prospective customers to understand their requirements, project details, business needs and purchase intent.
* Qualify leads based on defined business criteria, opportunity potential, urgency, location and other relevant parameters.
* Assign qualified leads to the appropriate sales representatives based on predefined allocation criteria.
* Ensure every new enquiry is contacted promptly and accurately recorded in the lead management system.

**B. Lead Follow-ups & Sales Coordination**

* Manage an active pipeline of new, ongoing and carry-forward leads.
* Conduct systematic follow-ups with prospects to collect pending information, understand buying timelines and assess the next steps.
* Coordinate with sales representatives to facilitate customer meetings, technical discussions and site visits.
* Ensure prospects receive timely responses and that no active opportunity is missed due to inadequate follow-up.
* Support the sales team throughout the sales cycle by maintaining communication with prospects and facilitating progression towards conversion.
* Escalate high-potential, urgent or delayed opportunities to management.

**C. Lead Data Management & Sales Prioritisation**

* Maintain accurate, updated and well-organised lead databases.
* Track lead status, source, customer requirements, follow-up dates, sales ownership and next actions.
* Develop and maintain structured lead trackers and daily/weekly sales pipeline reports.
* Identify high-priority prospects based on readiness, potential, urgency and engagement.
* Organise customer and site visit schedules geographically, identifying location-wise and route-wise clusters to optimise travel time and sales team productivity.
* Ensure proper documentation and visibility of all lead interactions and follow-up commitments.

**D. Customer Communication**

* Handle daily telecalling, email communication and WhatsApp correspondence with prospective customers.
* Communicate professionally and confidently with customers across different business segments.
* Share preliminary product information, company details and relevant communication material.
* Coordinate with technical and sales teams to obtain accurate responses to customer queries.

**E. Outbound Calling & Other Assignments**

* Undertake outbound calling activities and targeted prospecting as directed by management.
* Support specific sales campaigns, customer re-engagement initiatives and database activation.
* Take ownership of additional sales coordination and lead management activities as required.

**3. Expected Daily Workload**

The role will involve managing a combination of fresh enquiries, ongoing prospects and outbound activities.

Indicative daily activity:

* Tele calling in bound queries new prospect calls per day and documenting requirements in CRM
* Follow-ups with existing and carry-forward leads.
* Customer requirement validation and lead qualification.
* Coordination for sales meetings and site visits.
* Database updates, lead prioritisation and reporting.
* Additional outbound calls as assigned by management.

The actual calling volume will vary depending on incoming lead volumes and the active sales pipeline.

**4. Education & Experience**

**Preferred Experience:**

* Experience in the water treatment, wastewater management, industrial utilities or environmental solutions industry will be an advantage.
* Alternatively, candidates with sales coordination, telecalling, inside sales, customer relationship management or business development experience in technical or industrial sectors may apply.
* Fresh graduates or postgraduates with a strong interest in sales, excellent communication skills and a willingness to learn are also welcome.

**Educational Qualification:**

* Any graduate or postgraduate degree.
* Candidates with technical or engineering backgrounds will have an added advantage.

**5. Skills & Competencies**

* Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
* Fluency in English, Hindi and Telugu is mandatory.
* Strong telecalling, customer interaction and follow-up capabilities.
* Good organisational skills and attention to detail.
* Ability to manage multiple leads and prioritise tasks independently.
* Proficiency in MS Excel, Google Sheets, email and WhatsApp communication.
* Ability to maintain structured databases, trackers and reports.
* Good interpersonal skills and the ability to coordinate effectively with sales and technical teams.
* Proactive, disciplined, persistent and target-oriented approach.
* Strong learning agility and willingness to understand technical products and solutions.

**6. Product & Technical Knowledge**

Hydromo will provide structured training on its products, solutions and services. The candidate will be expected to progressively develop:

* Understanding of Hydromo's water treatment and wastewater management solutions.
* Basic knowledge of product applications, technical terminology and customer requirements.
* Ability to understand preliminary project requirements and capture relevant technical information.
* Confidence in communicating basic product information and coordinating technical discussions with the relevant teams.

Prior technical expertise is not mandatory, but the willingness and ability to learn technical concepts quickly is essential.

**7. Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)**

Performance will be evaluated on:

* Timely response and coverage of new inbound enquiries.
* Quality and accuracy of lead qualification.
* Number of leads effectively followed up and progressed.
* Accuracy and completeness of lead database and CRM records.
* Timely allocation of qualified leads to sales representatives.
* Effectiveness in facilitating customer meetings and site visits.
* Follow-up discipline and reduction in missed or dormant opportunities.
* Quality of daily and weekly reporting.
* Contribution to improving sales team productivity and lead-to-conversion timelines.

**8. Ideal Candidate Profile**

We are looking for someone who is:

* A confident communicator who can engage professionally with customers.
* Highly organised and comfortable managing multiple conversations and follow-ups.
* Persistent without being pushy.
* Data-oriented, with the ability to identify and prioritise promising opportunities.
* Responsible and accountable for ensuring every lead is tracked and acted upon.
* Enthusiastic about sales, customer engagement and learning technical products.

The objective of this role is simple: Ensure every genuine enquiry is contacted, qualified, tracked, followed up and effectively moved towards a sales opportunity — without allowing potential business to slip through the cracks.

Company: Hydromo

Location: Jubilee Hills, Hyderabad

Work Mode: Full-time | Work from Office

Working Days: Monday to Saturday

Working Hours: 9:30 AM – 6:30 PM

For apply : jobs@hydromo.in

title: Accounts Executive
description:
Job Summary

LEADSPACE is looking for a detail-oriented and responsible Finance & Accounts Executive to handle day-to-day accounting, billing, invoicing, financial documentation, payment processing, and other backend accounting activities at our Madhapur, Hyderabad office.

The ideal candidate should have practical experience in Tally ERP 9 / Tally Prime, a good understanding of accounting principles, GST, banking transactions, and financial reporting. The candidate will coordinate with internal departments, vendors, customers, and management to ensure smooth financial operations and accurate maintenance of company accounts.

Key Responsibilities

**Accounting & Bookkeeping**

Handle day-to-day accounting entries and financial transactions using Tally ERP 9 / Tally Prime. Maintain sales, purchase, journal, payment, receipt, and contra entries. Maintain general ledgers, cash books, bank books, and other accounting records. Verify and record financial transactions with supporting documents. Ensure accurate bookkeeping and maintain proper filing and documentation of all accounting records.

**Billing & Invoicing**

Prepare and process sales invoices, purchase invoices, debit notes, and credit notes. Verify invoices, quotations, purchase orders, and supporting documents. Maintain billing trackers and ensure timely submission of invoices. Coordinate with internal teams to resolve billing discrepancies and maintain accurate billing records.

**Accounts Payable & Receivable**

Maintain accounts payable and accounts receivable records. Process vendor bills and verify payment details before processing. Monitor customer outstanding balances and payment due dates. Follow up with customers and internal teams for pending payments. Maintain vendor ledgers and customer account statements. Prepare outstanding payment reports and ageing reports.

**GST & Statutory Compliance**

Prepare GST-related invoices and maintain supporting documentation. Assist in GSTR-1 and GSTR-3B data preparation and reconciliation. Verify GST details, GSTINs, tax rates, and input tax credit records. Coordinate with the Finance Head or external accountant for GST returns and statutory compliance. Maintain TDS-related records and assist with TDS calculations, deductions, and documentation wherever applicable.

**Bank Reconciliation & Payments**

Perform bank reconciliation and resolve discrepancies. Verify bank statements, payment receipts, and transaction records. Maintain records of NEFT, RTGS, IMPS, UPI, and cheque transactions. Prepare payment schedules and coordinate for timely vendor payments. Maintain petty cash records and daily cash transactions, wherever applicable.

**Purchase Orders & Vendor Management**

Prepare and maintain Purchase Orders (POs) and vendor-related documentation. Verify vendor quotations, bills, work orders, and supporting documents. Coordinate with vendors for invoices, payment confirmations, and account statements. Maintain vendor master data and ensure accurate financial records.

**Finance & MIS Reporting**

Prepare daily, weekly, and monthly accounting reports. Maintain Excel-based financial trackers and reports. Prepare expense statements, outstanding reports, payment reports, and reconciliation statements. Assist in monthly closing activities and financial data preparation. Support budgeting, expense monitoring, and management reporting.

**General Accounts Backend Activities**

Handle accounting data entry, document verification, and financial record maintenance. Verify employee expense claims, reimbursements, and supporting bills. Maintain records of office expenses, utility bills, rent, and other operational expenses. Assist with payroll-related accounting entries and salary payment documentation. Support internal and external audits by providing the required records. Coordinate with Sales, Operations, HR, Administration, vendors, and management for accounts-related matters. Perform other accounting and finance-related duties assigned by management.

Required Skills & Qualifications

A Bachelor's degree in Commerce (B.Com), Finance, or Accounting is preferred. Candidates should have 1–5 years of experience in Accounts, Finance, Billing, or Bookkeeping. Practical knowledge of Tally ERP 9 / Tally Prime is mandatory. A good understanding of accounting principles, bookkeeping, GST invoicing, GST reconciliation, and basic statutory compliance is required. Candidates should have experience in accounts payable, accounts receivable, bank reconciliation, and financial documentation. Proficiency in MS Excel, including formulas, data management, and report preparation, is mandatory. Knowledge of TDS, vendor reconciliation, and financial reporting will be an advantage. Strong numerical accuracy, attention to detail, organizational skills, and good communication and coordination abilities are essential.

Preferred Candidate Profile

Candidates with experience in advertising, media, real estate, or service-based industries are preferred. Experience in independently handling complete accounts backend operations will be an advantage. Knowledge of purchase orders, vendor management, billing, payment follow-ups, GST, and TDS documentation will be preferred. Candidates who can join immediately will be given preference.

**1. Job Summary**

We are looking for a results-driven International E-commerce Sales professional to manage and expand the company's global online sales business through leading international marketplaces, including Amazon Global, Walmart Marketplace, and other relevant e-commerce platforms.

The candidate will be responsible for developing international marketplace sales, managing product listings, identifying new business opportunities, optimizing product visibility, driving revenue growth, and coordinating with internal teams to ensure smooth international order fulfillment.

The ideal candidate should have hands-on experience in international e-commerce operations, marketplace management, digital sales strategies, and cross-border business development, preferably within the FMCG or consumer products industry.

**2. Key Responsibilities**

**A. International Marketplace Sales**

* Manage and grow sales across international marketplaces, including Amazon US, UK, Canada, Australia, and other relevant global markets.
* Develop and execute sales strategies to increase international revenue, market share, and product visibility.
* Manage and expand business on Walmart Marketplace and other international e-commerce platforms.
* Identify new global marketplaces and online sales channels suitable for the company's product portfolio.
* Research international markets to identify growth opportunities, customer demand, and competitor strategies.
* Establish sales targets and monitor marketplace performance against revenue and profitability objectives.

**B. Marketplace Account Management**

* Manage seller accounts, product catalogs, inventory availability, pricing, promotions, and sales performance.
* Create, optimize, and maintain product listings, including titles, descriptions, images, keywords, and product attributes.
* Ensure product listings comply with individual marketplace guidelines and category requirements.
* Monitor account health, customer feedback, product reviews, returns, and marketplace performance metrics.
* Resolve listing issues, account suspensions, catalog errors, and other marketplace-related concerns.
* Coordinate with marketplace support teams to resolve operational and commercial issues.

**C. Sales Growth**

* Plan and execute marketplace advertising campaigns, including Amazon Ads and Walmart Connect, where applicable.
* Monitor advertising performance, conversion rates, return on ad spend (ROAS), and customer acquisition costs.
* Implement promotional campaigns, deals, discounts, and seasonal sales strategies.
* Conduct keyword research and optimize product listings to improve organic search rankings.
* Analyze customer behavior, market trends, and competitor pricing to improve sales performance.
* Work towards achieving monthly and quarterly sales and profitability targets.

**D. International Business Development**

* Identify and evaluate new countries, marketplaces, distributors, and online retail partners.
* Develop strategies to expand the company's presence in international markets.
* Research market demand, pricing structures, competitor products, and customer preferences across different countries.
* Explore opportunities for direct-to-consumer sales and cross-border e-commerce.
* Build relationships with marketplace representatives, international distributors, and relevant business partners.
* Support the development of new international sales channels and commercial partnerships.
* Present marketplace performance, key challenges, and growth plans to management.

**3. Required Skills and Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Marketing, International Business, E-commerce, or a related field.
* 3–5 years of experience in international e-commerce sales, marketplace management, or global online business development.
* Hands-on experience managing Amazon Seller Central and/or Vendor Central for international markets.
* Experience with Walmart Marketplace is highly preferred.
* Knowledge of other global marketplaces and e-commerce channels is an advantage.
* Understanding of international sales, cross-border e-commerce, and global marketplace operations.
* Experience in product listing optimization, pricing, promotions, and marketplace advertising.
* Strong analytical skills with the ability to interpret sales data and marketplace performance reports.
* Proficiency in Microsoft Excel and marketplace analytics tools.
* Good communication, negotiation, and coordination skills.
* Ability to work independently and achieve revenue and profitability targets.

**4. Preferred Experience**

* Experience in FMCG, food products, packaged consumer goods, or other consumer product categories.
* Experience selling products in the US, UK, Canada, Australia, or other international markets.
* Understanding of international marketplace fees, fulfillment models, inventory planning, and product profitability.
* Experience with Amazon FBA, FBM, or other relevant international fulfillment models.
* Familiarity with international product compliance, labeling requirements, and export documentation.
* Experience in launching new products on international marketplaces and scaling them into profitable businesses.

**6. Ideal Candidate Profile**

The ideal candidate is commercially driven, analytically strong, and experienced in growing online sales across international markets. They should understand how to launch, manage, and scale products on global e-commerce platforms while maintaining healthy margins and operational efficiency.

The candidate must be comfortable working with sales data, marketplace dashboards, advertising campaigns, inventory planning, and cross-functional teams to drive sustainable international business growth.

**Primary Objective:** To establish and scale the company's international e-commerce business by increasing sales, expanding global marketplace presence, and delivering profitable growth across Amazon Worldwide, Walmart Marketplace, and other international online sales channels.

title: Market Data Lead
description:
**Job title** : Market Data Lead

  

* **Location** *: Hyderabad*

  

**Opella** is the self-care challenger with the purest and third-largest portfolio in the Over-The-Counter (OTC) & Vitamins, Minerals & Supplements (VMS) market globally.

Our mission is to bring health in people's hands by making self-care as simple as it should be for over half a billion consumers worldwide.

At the core of this mission is our 100+ loved brands, our 11,000-strong global team, our 13 best-in-class manufacturing sites, and four specialized science and innovation development centers.

Headquartered in France, Opella is the proud maker of many of the world's most loved brands, including Allegra, Buscopan, Doliprane, Dulcolax, Enterogermina, Essentiale, and Mucosolvan.

B Corp certified in multiple markets, we are active players in the journey towards healthier people and planet.

Find out more about our mission to bring health in your hands at www.opella.com

  

The **Digital Data, AI & Analytics team** at Opella drives transformation through data-driven decision-making, advanced analytics, and AI-powered solutions. Within this team, the **Master Data, Data Governance & Market Data group** ensures robust data practices, governance, and actionable insights to support strategic business decisions across the organization.

  
  

**Role Purpose**

The **Market Data Lead** is accountable for the strategy, evolution, adoption and value realization of **Market Data Foundation (MDF)** , Opella's global market data and sell-out intelligence data foundation.

MDF provides a centralized foundation for **Global Sell-Out (SO), Point-of-Sale (POS) and syndicated market data** , bringing together data from external market-data providers such as IQVIA, Circana and other strategic sources across markets. The platform enables standardized, trusted and timely access to market performance, growth, competitive and market-share insights.

The Market Data Lead acts as the **strategic bridge between business, data, technology and external data providers** , translating business needs into a clear product vision and roadmap while ensuring that the underlying data products are scalable, governed, reliable and fit for decision-making.

The role owns the product from **strategy and prioritization through delivery, adoption, continuous improvement and value realization** .

**Key Accountabilities**
------------------------

### **1. MDF Strategy & Vision**

* Define and continuously evolve the **vision, strategy and multi-year roadmap** in alignment with Opella's business and data strategy.
* Establish a clear product operating model covering business capabilities, data products, technology, governance and user experience.
* Identify opportunities to increase the business value generated from market and sell-out data.
* Translate strategic business priorities into a prioritized product backlog and investment roadmap.
* Balance short-term business needs with long-term scalability, standardization and architectural sustainability.
* Act as the primary product advocate for MDF across business and technology leadership.

### **2. Global MDF Ownership**

* Own the end-to-end lifecycle of MDF as a **global data product** .
* Define and maintain product requirements, capabilities, user journeys, data products and product standards.
* Drive the onboarding and industrialization of market data across countries, providers and data domains.
* Establish reusable approaches for data acquisition, integration, harmonization, quality management and consumption.
* Drive the evolution from market-specific solutions toward **standardized, scalable global capabilities** .
* Ensure that market data is accessible through fit-for-purpose products, APIs, analytical datasets and downstream consumption channels.

### **3. Data Provider & Vendor Management**

* Own the product relationship with strategic market-data providers and technology partners.
* Partner with Procurement, Legal, Finance and business stakeholders on vendor strategy, contracts, licensing and commercial considerations.
* Drive vendor consolidation and rationalization where appropriate.
* Establish clear expectations for data availability, quality, timeliness, service levels and issue resolution.
* Evaluate emerging market-data providers and new data sources based on business value, coverage, quality and scalability.
* Ensure effective management of provider dependencies and data licensing constraints.

### **4. Data Quality, Governance & Trust**

* Establish strong product-level accountability for **data quality, completeness, timeliness and usability** .
* Partner with Data Governance and Data Management teams to define and enforce relevant data standards.
* Ensure appropriate ownership of critical data elements, metadata, business definitions and data lineage.
* Drive resolution of systemic data-quality issues and recurring market/provider challenges.
* Establish product KPIs and data-quality measures that provide transparency to business stakeholders.
* Ensure that MDF remains a trusted source for market performance and competitive intelligence.

### **5. Product Delivery & Technology Partnership**

* Work closely with engineering, architecture, data platform and delivery teams to translate product requirements into scalable technical solutions.
* Own prioritization across enhancements, technical debt, platform modernization, data onboarding and business requests.
* Ensure delivery teams have clear objectives, requirements, acceptance criteria and measurable outcomes.
* Drive Agile product delivery practices and continuous improvement.
* Ensure architectural decisions support scalability across markets, data providers and future analytical use cases.
* Proactively identify technology risks, dependencies and opportunities for automation and simplification.

**6. Business Partnership & Adoption**

* Build strong relationships with global and local business stakeholders who consume market and sell-out data.
* Understand business problems and translate them into scalable product capabilities rather than market-specific solutions wherever possible.
* Drive adoption of MDF capabilities across relevant markets and functions.
* Establish mechanisms to capture user feedback and translate insights into product improvements.
* Develop product communications, enablement and adoption strategies for new capabilities.
* Demonstrate measurable business value from the product through improved data accessibility, speed, quality and decision-making.

### **7. Product Performance & Value Realization**

Define and monitor a product scorecard covering areas such as:

* Market and country coverage
* Data freshness and time-to-market
* Data quality and completeness
* User adoption and consumption
* Data-product availability
* Provider performance
* Cost efficiency
* Automation and operational efficiency
* Business value and stakeholder satisfaction

Use these measures to continuously optimize product investments and demonstrate MDF's contribution to Opella's data-driven decision-making agenda.

### **8. Innovation & Future Capabilities**

* Continuously evaluate opportunities to leverage **AI, automation, advanced analytics and modern data-product architectures** within the market-data ecosystem.
* Identify opportunities to reduce manual processes and improve data onboarding and validation.
* Explore new analytical capabilities that can be enabled through richer, standardized market data.
* Partner with Data & AI teams to identify opportunities for intelligent data quality, anomaly detection and automated insights.
* Keep the product aligned with evolving market-data, technology and industry practices.

**Key Stakeholders**

The Product Owner operates across a broad ecosystem of stakeholders, across Business teams, Digital and Technology teams, and External partners.

The role requires the ability to influence across organizational boundaries without relying solely on formal authority.

**Leadership & Ways of Working**
--------------------------------

The Product Owner is expected to operate as a **product leader and business partner** , with accountability for outcomes rather than simply delivery of requirements.

Key leadership expectations include:

* Think strategically while maintaining strong execution discipline.

* Create clarity in complex, multi-stakeholder environments.

* Make transparent and data-driven prioritization decisions.

* Challenge the status quo and simplify where possible.

* Build strong relationships between business and technology teams.

* Create accountability across internal teams and external partners.

* Communicate effectively with both senior executives and delivery teams.

* Drive change across markets while respecting local business needs.

* Champion product thinking, reuse and scalable solutions.

About you:

**Required Skills**

* Strong communication, negotiation, and interpersonal skills.
* Demonstrated conflict resolution & problem-solving skills in a global environment.
* Strong appetite to learn and discover, entrepreneur mindset.
* Adaptable and open to change.
* Team player, service-oriented.
* Analytical and synthetic, able to formalize solutions, good writing skills.
* Strong oral and written communication skills.
* With leadership attitude, autonomy and results driven.
* Role model our 4 values: teamwork, integrity, respect, courage.

* **Bachelor’s degree** in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, Data Science, Business, Economics, Mathematics, Statistics, or a related discipline.
* Significant experience in **Digital, Data, Analytics, Technology or Product Management** .
* Proven experience owning enterprise-scale digital or data products. Experience with **market data, syndicated data, sell-out/POS data, consumer insights or commercial analytics** .
* Experience working with providers such as **IQVIA, Circana or comparable market-data organizations** .
* Strong understanding of **data platforms, data integration, data governance and analytics ecosystems** .
* **Minimum 12+ years of professional experience** across Digital, Data, Analytics, Technology, Product Management, Consulting or related disciplines.
* **5+ years of experience in Product Management / Product Ownership** , preferably with enterprise-scale digital or data products.
* Proven experience owning the **strategy, roadmap, prioritization and lifecycle of complex data or technology products** .
* Experience working across **global, multi-market organizations** , managing stakeholders across business, technology and corporate functions.
* Demonstrated experience translating complex business needs into **scalable data and digital products** .
* Strong experience working with **data platforms, data integration, data governance, data quality and analytics ecosystems** .
* Experience managing **technology vendors, data providers, systems integrators and commercial partners** .
* Proven ability to lead **cross-functional teams and influence senior stakeholders without direct authority** .
* Experience managing complex product portfolios involving multiple dependencies, markets, technology teams and external partners.
* Demonstrated experience delivering measurable improvements in **data accessibility, quality, timeliness, adoption, cost efficiency or business value** .

**Preferred Experience**

* **Master’s degree** in Business Administration, Data Science, Computer Science, Information Systems, Analytics, Engineering or a related field.
* Relevant professional certifications in **Product Management, Data Management, Data Governance, Agile/Scrum, Cloud or Analytics** are advantageous.
* Experience in **Consumer Healthcare, FMCG, Pharmaceuticals, Life Sciences or another data-intensive industry** .
* Experience building or transforming **enterprise data products / data platforms** .
* Experience with modern cloud and data technologies such as **Snowflake, Databricks, AWS/Azure/GCP, APIs, data lakes/lakehouses and BI platforms** .
* Experience applying **AI, automation or advanced analytics** to data-product capabilities.
* Experience leading **data-platform modernization, vendor consolidation or global data transformation programs** .

**Core Competencies**

**Strategic Product Leadership**

* Product vision and strategy
* Roadmap development
* Portfolio prioritization
* Value realization

**Data & Technology**

* Data-product thinking
* Data architecture and integration
* Data governance and quality
* Cloud and modern data platforms
* Analytics and AI

**Business Leadership**

* Commercial acumen
* Global stakeholder management
* Executive communication
* Change management
* Influencing without authority

**Execution**

* Agile product management
* Delivery governance
* Vendor management
* Risk and dependency management
* Continuous improvement

**Success Measures**

Success in the role will be demonstrated through:

* Expansion of MDF's global market and data coverage.
* Improved availability, quality and timeliness of market data.
* Increased adoption and consumption of MDF data products.
* Reduced complexity, duplication and manual data processes.
* Improved scalability of onboarding new markets and data providers.
* Effective governance and accountability across the market-data ecosystem.
* Improved vendor and data-provider performance and cost efficiency.
* Delivery of measurable business value from market and sell-out data.
* A sustainable product roadmap aligned to Opella's broader Digital, Data & AI strategy.
* Re-establishment of MDF as a trusted, scalable global market-data product.
  

  

**Role Definition**

The Product Owner – MDF is accountable for making market data a scalable, trusted and business-oriented product, connecting data, technology and business needs to enable faster and better market decisions across Opella.

  

Why us?

  

At Opella, you will enjoy doing challenging, purposeful work, empowered to develop consumer brands with passion and creativity. This is your chance to grow new skills and be part of a bold, collaborative, and inclusive culture where people can thrive and be at their best every day.

  

**We Are Challengers.**

We are dedicated to making self-care as simple as it should be. That starts with our culture. We are challengers by nature, and this is how we do things:

  

**All In Together:** We keep each other honest and have each other's backs.

**Courageous:** We break boundaries and take thoughtful risks with creativity.

**Outcome-Obsessed:** We are personally accountable, driving sustainable impact and results with integrity.

**Radically Simple:** We strive to make things simple for us and simple for consumers, as it should be.

  

Join us on our mission. Health. In your hands.

title: Business Development Manager (BDM)
description:
Central Clothing is a woman-led garment manufacturing company based in Hyderabad, specializing in school uniforms, sportswear, corporate uniforms, and institutional apparel. We provide end-to-end uniform solutions to educational institutions, including uniforms, tracksuits, blazers, sweaters, bags, shoes, socks, belts, and other accessories.

Role Objective

We are looking for a proactive, target-driven Business Development Manager to identify schools and colleges across India that require uniforms, establish relationships with decision-makers, and convert business opportunities into confirmed purchase orders.

This is a work-from-home role requiring strong research, communication, follow-up, negotiation, and sales-closing skills.

Key Responsibilities

**1. Market Research & Lead Generation**

* Research schools, junior colleges, degree colleges, residential schools, and educational institutions across India.
* Identify institutions that are introducing new uniforms, changing vendors, expanding campuses, or preparing for the upcoming academic year.
* Identify decision-makers such as school management, principals, administrators, purchase managers, and procurement teams.
* Build and maintain a database of qualified prospects with contact details, uniform requirements, and purchase timelines.
* Track relevant government and private institutional tenders.

**2. Business Development & Outreach**

* Contact prospective institutions through telephone calls, emails, WhatsApp, LinkedIn, and other professional channels.
* Introduce Central Clothing and communicate its manufacturing capabilities, product range, quality, and pricing advantages.
* Schedule meetings and product presentations with school and college management.
* Understand the institution's requirements, student strength, uniform specifications, and annual procurement process.

**3. Lead Conversion & Purchase Order Closure**

* Obtain uniform specifications, sample requirements, estimated quantities, and quotation requests.
* Coordinate with Central Clothing's internal team to prepare quotations, product samples, and commercial proposals.
* Follow up consistently with prospects until quotations are approved and orders are confirmed.
* Negotiate pricing and commercial terms within company-approved limits.
* Drive the opportunity from initial contact to confirmed purchase order (PO).
* Maintain a pipeline of active opportunities and provide accurate sales forecasts.

**4. Relationship Management**

* Develop long-term relationships with school management and procurement teams.
* Identify cross-selling opportunities for sports uniforms, blazers, sweaters, bags, shoes, socks, belts, and other accessories.
* Maintain relationships with existing customers to generate repeat orders and referrals.

**5. Reporting & Accountability**

* Maintain a CRM or structured lead tracker with daily updates.
* Submit weekly reports covering new leads, decision-maker contacts, meetings, quotations, follow-ups, and orders closed.
* Track the sales pipeline, expected order value, probability of conversion, and next action for each prospect.
* Achieve agreed monthly and quarterly sales targets.

Required Skills & Qualifications

* Graduate in any discipline; a business or marketing qualification is an advantage.
* 2–5 years of experience in B2B sales, institutional sales, education sales, or business development preferred.
* Experience selling uniforms, textiles, garments, or institutional supplies is a strong advantage.
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
* Strong internet research and lead-generation abilities.
* Confidence in cold calling, negotiation, follow-ups, and closing deals.
* Comfortable using Excel/Google Sheets, email, WhatsApp Business, and CRM tools.
* Self-disciplined and capable of working independently from home.
* Willingness to work with measurable targets and performance-linked incentives.

Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

Performance will be measured by business outcomes rather than activity alone.

* Number of qualified school and college leads generated.
* Number of decision-makers contacted and meetings secured.
* Number of genuine quotation requests received.
* Value of qualified sales opportunities in the pipeline.
* Number and value of confirmed purchase orders.
* Conversion rate from qualified leads to orders.
* Revenue and gross margin generated.
* Repeat business and customer retention.

Compensation Structure

The compensation package will consist of:

* Fixed monthly salary, based on experience and suitability.
* Performance-linked incentives for successfully converted orders.
* Additional incentives for achieving or exceeding agreed sales targets.

The incentive structure, payment milestones, and eligibility conditions will be agreed upon in writing before joining.

Ideal Candidate

The ideal candidate is a self-motivated sales professional who knows how to find the right prospects, reach decision-makers, build trust, and close institutional business. We need someone who can independently develop a pipeline and generate measurable revenue—not merely compile contact lists.

**Primary goal: Convert school and college uniform requirements into profitable, confirmed purchase orders for Central Clothing.**

**JOB DESCRIPTION**
===================

**Field Sales Manager – B2C Sales (Steel Industry)**
----------------------------------------------------

**Company:** Steel on Call Services India Private Limited

**Department:** Sales & Business Development

**Designation:** Field Sales Manager – B2C

**Industry:** Steel / Iron & Steel – Mandatory

**Experience:** 6–7 Years

**Work Location:** (Territory-Based) - Secunderabad / Rangareddy

### **1. Job Purpose**

The Field Sales Manager – B2C will be responsible for driving sales growth, developing new customers, managing assigned territories, and expanding the company's presence in the retail steel market. The role involves direct field sales, customer relationship management, dealer and retailer network development, lead generation, and achieving sales targets across assigned territories.

### **2. Key Responsibilities**

**A. Territory Sales Management**

* Manage and develop assigned territories to achieve monthly, quarterly, and annual sales targets.
* Identify potential markets, new business opportunities, and untapped customer segments.
* Prepare territory-wise sales plans and execute strategies to increase market penetration.
* Conduct regular field visits to monitor market conditions, customer requirements, and competitor activities.
* Ensure effective coverage of all key locations within the assigned territory.

**B. B2C Sales & Customer Acquisition**

* Generate sales from individual customers, homeowners, contractors, fabricators, and small construction businesses.
* Identify and convert potential customers for steel products, including TMT bars, structural steel, MS products, and other relevant steel materials.
* Develop and maintain strong relationships with retail customers and end users.
* Generate leads through field visits, references, local networking, and other sales channels.
* Understand customer requirements and recommend suitable products based on their needs.

**C. Dealer, Retailer & Channel Development**

* Develop and maintain relationships with local steel dealers, retailers, fabricators, and contractors to support B2C sales.
* Identify potential channel partners and expand the company's customer network.
* Build a strong referral network to generate repeat business and new leads.
* Coordinate with internal teams to ensure timely order processing and customer service.

**D. Sales Planning & Target Achievement**

* Achieve assigned sales targets, revenue goals, and customer acquisition objectives.
* Prepare daily visit plans, weekly sales reports, and monthly territory performance reports.
* Track sales pipelines, follow up on leads, and ensure timely conversion of enquiries into orders.
* Monitor sales performance and implement corrective actions wherever required.
* Maintain accurate customer information, sales records, and market intelligence.

**E. Payment Follow-Up & Customer Service**

* Coordinate with customers and internal teams regarding order status, delivery schedules, and product availability.
* Follow up on outstanding payments and support timely collections in accordance with company policies.
* Resolve customer concerns and ensure a positive buying experience.
* Develop long-term customer relationships to encourage repeat purchases and referrals.

**F. Market Research & Competition Analysis**

* Monitor competitor pricing, product availability, promotional activities, and market trends.
* Identify new growth opportunities within assigned territories.
* Provide regular feedback to management regarding customer preferences, demand patterns, and market developments.

### **3. Educational Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Commerce, Marketing, or a related discipline.
* MBA/PGDM in Marketing or Sales will be an added advantage.

### **4. Required Experience & Skills**

* 6–7 years of experience in field sales, preferably in the steel or iron and steel industry.
* Mandatory experience in steel product sales and territory management.
* Strong understanding of the retail steel market and B2C customer acquisition.
* Proven track record of achieving sales targets and expanding customer networks.
* Excellent negotiation, communication, presentation, and relationship-building skills.
* Ability to independently manage territories and travel extensively for field sales.
* Strong lead-generation, sales planning, and follow-up capabilities.
* Proficiency in MS Excel, reporting tools, and CRM software is preferred.
* A valid two-wheeler or four-wheeler driving licence and own vehicle will be an advantage, depending on company requirements.

### **5. Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)**

* Achievement of monthly and annual sales targets.
* Number of new customers acquired.
* Territory-wise revenue growth and market penetration.
* Number of customer visits and qualified leads generated.
* Lead-to-order conversion rate.
* Repeat customer business and customer retention.
* Timely payment collections and reduction in overdue receivables.
* Accuracy and timeliness of sales reports.

### **6. Candidate Profile**

The ideal candidate should be a target-driven sales professional with strong field execution skills, hands-on experience in steel sales, and the ability to independently manage assigned territories. The candidate must be proactive in acquiring new B2C customers, developing local market networks, and driving sustainable sales growth.

### **7. Compensation**

Salary and incentives will be based on the candidate's experience, current compensation, and suitability for the role.

### **8. How to Apply**

Interested candidates with 6–7 years of relevant steel industry sales experience and a proven track record in B2C sales and territory management are encouraged to apply.

A significant part of your role will involve identifying new keyword opportunities, improving keyword performance, and driving profitable growth through continuous optimization. If you're someone who enjoys working with keywords, search data, campaign optimization, and scaling winning products, we'd love to hear from you.

Key Responsibilities

* Conduct extensive keyword research for new and existing products using Amazon Brand Analytics, Search Query Performance, Helium 10, DataHawk, and other keyword research tools

* Continuously discover new keyword opportunities through Search Term Reports and customer search behavior
* Monitor keyword rankings and identify opportunities to improve organic visibility
* Optimize keyword bids based on ACOS, ROAS, CTR, CVR, CPC, and conversion performance
* Regularly add negative keywords to eliminate wasted ad spend
* Perform ASIN and competitor targeting research to uncover new growth opportunities
* Collaborate with the catalog team to improve keyword indexing across product titles, bullet points, backend search terms, A+ Content, and Brand Store pages
* Maintain a structured keyword master sheet for every product and continuously expand the keyword universe
* Stay updated with Amazon search trends, seasonal keywords, and competitor activity

* Execute, set up, launch, and manage advertising campaigns on Amazon India

* Optimize bids, budgets, keywords, ASIN targeting, and placements
* Pause underperforming campaigns and scale winning campaigns
* Identify search term opportunities and add negative keywords
* Improve campaign efficiency while maintaining profitability
* Execute A/B tests across keywords, bidding strategies, targeting, and campaign structures

Analytics & Reporting

* Pull and analyze campaign performance data from the Amazon Advertising Console
* Track key metrics including ROAS, ACOS, TACOS, CPC, CTR, CVR, Impressions, Clicks, Orders, Sales, and Spend
* Analyze Search Term Reports to identify winning keywords and wasted spend

Budget Management & Scaling

* Strong understanding of Sponsored Products, Sponsored Brands, Sponsored Display, Auto and Manual campaigns

We at Corizo bring together the students aiming for successful careers, knowledge and experience accumulated over the years by our industry experts to create a holistic learning platform. Our platform helps students discover programs, and get trained in their fields of interest with the latest market requirements.

Collaborate with these institutions to create impactful online and offline learning experiences for students through events, boot camps, competitions, and hands-on projects. Recruitment – Lead the end-to-end recruitment process of Campus Ambassadors (CAs) from various campuses across the country. This includes identifying potential candidates, conducting interviews, and onboarding selected students who are enthusiastic about representing Corizo in their institutions.

Leadership & Training – Manage and mentor a team of Campus Ambassadors by providing structured training sessions, setting performance goals, and offering continuous guidance. Foster leadership qualities in CAs and create a supportive environment that encourages collaboration, growth, and high performance.

Marketing – Strategize and implement creative marketing campaigns in collaboration with Campus Ambassadors to boost brand awareness and student engagement. Utilize digital platforms and on- ground initiatives to promote Corizo’s programs effectively among the student community.

Sales Enablement – Work closely with the sales team and Campus Ambassadors to drive student registrations and program conversions. Leverage student networks and insights to generate qualified leads, promote course offerings, and achieve monthly sales targets through campus-driven outreach efforts.

**Location:** Hyderabad, Telangana  
**Work arrangement:** Full-time, office-based  
**Market:** United States  
**Experience:** Preferably 3–7 years in US IT staffing business development or client acquisition  
**Working hours:** Must overlap with US business hours; night-shift availability required.

Role Objective

Softcom is looking for a results-driven Business Development Manager to acquire new US clients and staffing partners. The individual will own the client acquisition process, from prospect outreach and relationship development to vendor onboarding, MSA execution and obtaining active staffing requirements.

AI-assisted lead generation is already available. This role is focused on converting researched prospects into business opportunities, not merely collecting leads.

Key Responsibilities1. Direct Client Acquisition

* Identify and establish relationships with US companies requiring IT staffing services.
* Reach hiring managers, talent acquisition leaders, HR leaders and procurement decision-makers.
* Conduct cold calls, personalized email campaigns and LinkedIn outreach.
* Present Softcom’s capabilities and develop long-term client relationships.
* Secure new accounts and obtain active staffing requirements.

2. Staffing Partner and Prime Contractor Development

* Build relationships with US staffing firms, recruitment vendors and prime contractors.
* Identify subcontracting and vendor partnership opportunities.
* Complete vendor registration and onboarding processes.
* Negotiate and coordinate MSAs and other required agreements.
* Develop recurring sources of qualified staffing requirements.

3. Opportunity Conversion

* Review qualified company and hiring intelligence generated through Softcom’s AI-assisted research process.
* Identify the appropriate decision-makers and personalize the outreach strategy.
* Schedule discovery meetings and conduct follow-ups.
* Move prospects through the pipeline: contacted, engaged, meeting, vendor onboarding, agreement signed and active requirements received.
* Coordinate with recruitment to ensure smooth handoff of requirements.

4. Pipeline Management and Reporting

* Maintain an accurate prospect and opportunity tracker.
* Record all outreach, conversations, meetings, follow-ups and next steps.
* Provide daily activity reports and weekly pipeline reviews.
* Report measurable progress in client acquisition, agreements, active requirements and revenue potential.

Initial Performance Expectations

* 15–20 personalized emails per working day.
* 15–20 LinkedIn outreach activities per working day.
* 15–25 cold calls per working day.
* 3–5 meaningful prospect conversations per day as an initial target.
* 4–6 qualified client meetings during the first 30 days.
* Build a measurable pipeline of new client and staffing-partner opportunities.
* Work toward obtaining 1–2 genuine staffing requirements within the first 30 days, recognizing that results depend on the sales cycle and market response.

Targets will be reviewed against lead quality, conversion rates and actual progress.

Required Experience and Skills

* Proven experience in US IT staffing business development or new client acquisition.
* Experience with cold calling, email outreach, LinkedIn prospecting and relationship building.
* Familiarity with US staffing vendors, direct clients and vendor onboarding processes.
* Understanding of staffing agreements, MSAs, subcontracting and staffing requirements.
* Excellent spoken and written English.
* Strong follow-up discipline, negotiation skills and ability to handle rejection.
* Ability to work independently and meet measurable targets.

Preferred Qualifications

* Existing relationships with US staffing companies or direct clients.
* Experience with prime contractors, federal contractors, MSPs or VMS programs.
* Experience using CRM systems, LinkedIn Sales Navigator or similar sales tools.

Success Measures

The successful candidate will be evaluated on qualified meetings, new client relationships, vendor onboarding, executed agreements, active staffing requirements and eventual revenue—not simply the number of calls or emails sent.

**This is a client acquisition role. The primary responsibility is to bring new business to Softcom.**

Leads and manages all day-to-day activities related to the sales function with a focus on building long-term, value-based customer relationships that enable achievement of property sales objectives. Achieves personal booking goals and makes recommendations on booking goals of direct reports.

description:
**Business Development & Proposal Manager – U.S. Government Contracts**

Department Business Development / Proposal Management

Location Onsite – Madhapur, Hyderabad, India – 500081

Industry Civil Engineering / Infrastructure / Engineering Consulting

Employment Type Full-Time

Work Hours 4:00 PM – 1:00 AM IST

Experience 10+ years of relevant experience

Capture & Proposal Manager

Proposal Manager – U.S. Government Contracts

About the Role

We are seeking an experienced Business Development & Proposal Manager to lead opportunity identification, market intelligence, bid strategy, and end-to-end proposal management for our U.S. civil engineering and infrastructure business. The role will focus on identifying and qualifying U.S. federal, state, county, and municipal government opportunities; analyzing RFPs and RFQs; developing compliant and competitive proposals; coordinating with technical and commercial teams; and maintaining a strong pipeline of upcoming opportunities.

The ideal candidate will have hands-on experience managing U.S. government bids and proposals, a strong understanding of government procurement processes, excellent proposal-writing and analytical skills, and the ability to translate business opportunities into well-structured, competitive submissions. **Prior hands-on experience supporting or managing U.S. government contracts at both federal and state/local levels is mandatory.** Experience in civil engineering, infrastructure, construction inspection, geotechnical engineering, or engineering consulting is highly preferred.

1. Business Development & Opportunity Identification

· Identify, research, and qualify new business opportunities across U.S. federal, state, county, and municipal government agencies.

· Monitor government procurement portals, including SAM.gov and state/local procurement platforms, for relevant solicitations.

· Identify opportunities related to civil engineering, geotechnical engineering, construction materials testing, construction inspection, infrastructure monitoring, and engineering consulting services.

· Develop and maintain a pipeline of upcoming, active, and potential business opportunities.

· Conduct market research to understand client requirements, upcoming projects, procurement trends, and competitor activity.

· Support management in evaluating new markets, target agencies, strategic accounts, and potential partnerships.

· Maintain opportunity trackers and provide regular pipeline updates to leadership.

2. Bid Strategy & Opportunity Qualification

· Review and evaluate RFPs, RFQs, Requests for Information (RFIs), Expressions of Interest (EOIs), and other government solicitations.

· Assess solicitation requirements, eligibility criteria, scope of work, evaluation methodology, submission deadlines, and contractual conditions.

· Coordinate bid/no-bid evaluations with leadership and relevant technical and commercial stakeholders.

· Identify proposal requirements, compliance risks, resource needs, and potential differentiators.

· Develop proposal schedules, compliance matrices, responsibility assignments, and submission plans.

· Track amendments, addenda, clarifications, and changes to solicitation requirements.

3. End-to-End Proposal & Bid Management

· Lead the complete proposal lifecycle, from opportunity identification and qualification through submission and post-submission follow-up.

· Manage the preparation of technical proposals, management approaches, project understanding, staffing plans, past-performance references, and supporting documentation.

· Develop proposal outlines, response matrices, submission checklists, and compliance documents.

· Coordinate with engineering, project management, operations, finance, legal, and leadership teams to collect proposal inputs.

· Ensure proposals address all solicitation requirements and evaluation criteria.

· Review submissions for accuracy, consistency, completeness, compliance, and overall presentation.

· Manage proposal deadlines and ensure timely submission through the appropriate procurement portals.

· Coordinate post-submission clarifications, interviews, presentations, and follow-up activities.

4. Proposal Writing & Content Development

· Develop clear, persuasive, and technically sound proposal narratives aligned with U.S. government solicitation requirements.

· Prepare and refine executive summaries, technical approaches, staffing methodologies, management plans, and project-specific responses.

· Maintain a centralized library of company qualifications, project descriptions, past-performance records, resumes, certifications, and standard proposal content.

· Develop and maintain company capability statements, corporate profiles, and agency-specific qualifications packages.

· Work with subject-matter experts to translate technical information into clear, compliant, client-focused proposals.

· Continuously improve proposal quality, consistency, and competitiveness.

5. Commercial & Pricing Coordination

· Coordinate with management, engineering, estimation, and finance teams to develop competitive commercial proposals.

· Review pricing inputs, labor categories, resource requirements, assumptions, and commercial terms.

· Ensure proposed pricing and supporting documentation align with solicitation instructions.

· Identify commercial risks, contractual exceptions, and compliance concerns for management review.

· Support responses to commercial clarifications and post-submission negotiations, where applicable.

6. U.S. Government Procurement & Compliance

· Apply practical knowledge of U.S. federal and state/local government procurement processes and solicitation requirements.

· Ensure compliance with proposal instructions, mandatory forms, representations, certifications, and submission procedures.

· Coordinate the collection and maintenance of corporate registrations, insurance documentation, relevant certifications, and other supporting records.

· Track contract requirements, amendments, submission milestones, and procurement-related communications.

· Work with internal stakeholders to identify and address proposal compliance gaps before submission.

7. Market Intelligence & Competitive Analysis

· Research government agencies, procurement forecasts, infrastructure programs, and upcoming engineering projects.

· Analyze competitors, contract awards, incumbent contractors, market positioning, and available business intelligence.

· Identify potential clients and opportunities aligned with the company’s service portfolio.

· Maintain records of bid outcomes and analyze win/loss trends.

· Provide management with insights on market opportunities, competitive positioning, and potential areas for business growth.

8. Client & Stakeholder Coordination

· Coordinate with U.S.-based leadership, business development teams, technical personnel, and other stakeholders throughout the bid lifecycle.

· Support client communications, pre-bid meetings, clarification requests, and proposal presentations.

· Develop a clear understanding of client requirements and procurement priorities.

· Support the development of long-term client relationships and strategic partnerships.

· Coordinate with internal teams following contract awards to ensure an effective handover of relevant bid commitments and documentation.

9. Reporting & Performance Management

· Maintain accurate records of opportunities, active bids, submissions, awards, and lost opportunities.

· Prepare periodic reports on pipeline value, proposal status, submission deadlines, and bid outcomes.

· Track proposal turnaround time, submission compliance, and win rates.

· Provide regular updates and recommendations to management regarding pipeline development and proposal performance.

Required Skills & Competencies

· Demonstrated hands-on experience with U.S. federal and state/local government bids and proposals.

· Strong knowledge of U.S. government procurement processes and solicitation requirements.

· Proven experience managing end-to-end bid and proposal activities.

· Excellent technical and business proposal-writing skills.

· Strong analytical, research, and opportunity-evaluation capabilities.

· Experience preparing compliance matrices, bid schedules, and proposal response plans.

· Ability to coordinate multiple proposals and meet strict deadlines.

· Strong written and verbal communication skills.

· Excellent stakeholder-management, coordination, and follow-up skills.

· Strong attention to detail and a structured approach to documentation.

· Ability to work independently while coordinating effectively with U.S.-based teams.

Technical & Software Skills

· Proficiency in Microsoft Word, Excel, and PowerPoint.

· Hands-on familiarity with SAM.gov and U.S. state, county, and municipal procurement portals.

· Experience with government solicitation documents, proposal templates, and compliance matrices.

· Familiarity with CRM platforms, opportunity-tracking tools, and bid/proposal management systems.

· Experience with proposal content libraries and document collaboration tools is preferred.

· Exposure to BOQs, cost estimates, and technical engineering documentation is an advantage.

Educational Qualifications

· Bachelor’s degree in Civil Engineering, Construction Management, or a related discipline preferred.

· A degree in Business Administration, Marketing, or Management may be considered for candidates with substantial relevant experience.

· PMP, proposal management, or relevant professional certifications are an advantage.

Experience Requirements

· 10+ years of relevant experience in bid management, proposal management, business development, tendering, or pre-sales.

· Mandatory hands-on experience supporting or managing U.S. government contracts at both federal and state/local levels.

· Experience in civil engineering, infrastructure, construction, geotechnical engineering, or engineering consulting is highly preferred.

· Experience coordinating technical and commercial proposals for professional services or engineering projects is strongly preferred.

· Candidates whose experience is limited to Indian government tenders or non-U.S. private-sector bidding will not meet the mandatory U.S. government contracting requirement.

Preferred Candidate Profile

The ideal candidate is a proposal and bid management professional who understands the U.S. government contracting environment, can independently manage complex proposal submissions, identifies relevant business opportunities, and works effectively with technical teams and U.S.-based leadership to develop competitive bids.

The role requires a balance of business development, opportunity research, proposal leadership, procurement compliance, and stakeholder coordination rather than a purely sales-oriented or construction-estimation-focused background.

Lexi is an AI workspace built for Indian litigation lawyers. We bring legal research, drafting, case tracking, and day-to-day practice management into one platform, enabling advocates, chambers, and law firms to operate faster and more productively.

Headquartered in Hyderabad, our founding team focuses on high-impact execution. You will work closely with the founders to take our product directly into independent chambers, law firms, and advocate offices across the city, executing and scaling our field sales playbook.

What You’ll Do

* **Scheduled Field Demos:** Take ownership of warm, qualified meetings handed over by the inside sales team, conducting 3–5 in-person demos daily across law firms and advocate chambers to engage directly with chamber heads, partners, and senior litigators.
* **Hands-On Desk Demos & Trial Activation:** Run interactive, desk-side walkthroughs tailored to litigation workflows—setting up immediate trial access on lawyers' devices and demonstrating how Lexi accelerates their daily drafting, legal research, and case tracking.
* **Trial Nurturing & Deal Closing:** Follow up methodically post-demo through office visits, WhatsApp, email, and calls to address workflow questions, handle objections, and convert trials into paid annual or monthly subscriptions.
* **CRM & Qualitative Feedback:** Log detailed visit notes, lawyer pain points, objections, and deal stages daily in our CRM to help the founders refine the product roadmap and optimize pitch positioning.

What We’re Looking For

* **Field / Direct Sales Experience:** Prior experience in B2B field sales/SDR/BDR roles, corporate client visits, software demonstrations, or merchant/professional onboarding.

* **Self-Initiative & Accountability:** High ownership over your daily visit calendar, demo conversions, pipeline tracking, and reporting back to the leadership team.

* **Full-Cycle Sales Ownership:** You won't simply drop brochures or collect cards,you will run live product walkthroughs, handle objections, negotiate pricing, and close paid accounts.

title: Solution Consultant
description:
Rockwell Automation is a global technology leader focused on helping the world’s manufacturers be more productive, sustainable, and agile. With more than 28,000 employees who make the world better every day, we know we have something special. Behind our customers - amazing companies that help feed the world, provide life-saving medicine on a global scale, and focus on clean water and green mobility - our people are energized problem solvers that take pride in how the work we do changes the world for the better.

We welcome all makers, forward thinkers, and problem solvers who are looking for a place to do their best work. And if that’s you we would love to have you join us!

Job Description

**Solution Consultant**

**Hyderabad**

You will support sales at main customer pursuits by providing specific solution expertise in a defined geographical area. The Solution Consultant is the solution expert for the sales organization by assisting with delivering outcome-based messaging to customers at executive and management levels. The Solution Consultant has a broad understanding of all related products and delivery offerings from Rockwell, partners and competitors in the designated solution area.

You will report to the Industry & Consulting Leader and work onsite in Hyderabad, India.

**Your Responsibilities:**

* You will be the focal point in the defined geography for the solution(s), of which you have been designated as an expert.
* You will participate in account planning and sales strategy focusing on new customer acquisition and existing customer expansion.
* You will facilitate and provide training to the sales team on the values and outcomes of specific solution(s).
* You will co-operate with the sales team in promoting the solution to all customers with presentations and demonstrations. Advise Technology Consultants and sales on proposal generation and validation.
* Assist sales at proposal presentations for executive level customers Define and articulate differentiators and values versus competition for the solution.
* Analyse products, have knowledge of competitor's strategy, further define competitive differentiators.
* Translate competitive solutions into a Rockwell automation solution that meets customer's expectations.
* Seek out and participate in training opportunities to develop technical skills.
* Provide product gap and development feedback for the solution to appropriate organisations.
* Share insights with peers. Focus on opportunities that support Rockwell Automation's strategy.
* Understand business models, organisation, and go-to-market strategy. Knowledge of industry strategies, familiarity with outcome-based selling.
* Share industry knowledge of customers based on their important causes at the appropriate role level with all customers. Keep sales and customer relationship management data up to date in local agreed upon tools, such as SFA, and improve by using these tools.

**The Essentials** - You Will Have:

* Bachelor's degree in an engineering/technical related field or equivalent experience.
* Value of larger Rockwell Automation application value, without the need to demonstrate individual products with hands-on demonstrations Solution and application expertise, and related demonstrated sales experience. Fluency in native language and command of English (written and spoken).
* Work with and gain confidence of senior level personnel (internal and external) in a collaborative, matrixed organisation.
* Align and influence critical partners.
* Support customer centricity.
* Understand the importance of demonstrating concern for satisfying customers.
* Passionate about developing goals to improve our customer experience.
* Set, be accountable for and achieve challenging targets. empower, coach and motivate others. Communication style and messaging to different audiences.

**The Preferred - You Might Also Have:**

* 10+ Years of experience in consulting of Industrial automation products, proficiency in hands-on engineering.
* High level of expertise in Continuous and Batch Process Control which shall include knowledge of multiple ISA standards, practical experience designing and deploying control and electrical systems and solutions, High level of Application Knowledge.
* Practical knowledge of process unit operations and typical automation requirements of such process units Experience of the Process industry goals.
* Intermediate level of expertise in MES/Information Solutions, Networks and Services and Solutions, with a basic understanding of automation and electrical devices. Intermediate level of Industry Knowledge and Selling Skills.

**What We Offer:**

Our benefits package includes …

* Comprehensive mindfulness programs with a premium membership to Calm
* Volunteer Paid Time off available after 6 months of employment for eligible employees
* Company volunteer and donation matching program – Your volunteer hours or personal cash donations to an eligible charity can be matched with a charitable donation.
* Employee Assistance Program
* Personalized wellbeing programs through our OnTrack program
* On-demand digital course library for professional development ... and other local benefits!

*At Rockwell Automation we are dedicated to building a diverse, inclusive and authentic workplace, so if you're excited about this role but your experience doesn't align perfectly with every qualification in the job description, we encourage you to apply anyway. You may be just the right person for this or other roles.*
