title: Global Sales Effectiveness Director
description:
**Description**

**Who is USP?**

**Standardized language for consistency (do not delete):**

The U.S. Pharmacopeial Convention (USP) is an independent scientific organization that collaborates with the world’s leading health and science experts to develop rigorous quality standards for medicines, dietary supplements, and food ingredients. At USP, we believe that scientific excellence is driven by a commitment to fairness, integrity, and global collaboration. This belief is embedded in our core value of Passion for Quality and is demonstrated through the contributions of more than 1,300 professionals across twenty global locations, working to strengthen the supply of safe, high-quality medicines worldwide.

At USP, we value inclusive scientific collaboration and recognize that attracting diverse expertise strengthens our ability to develop trusted public health standards. We foster an organizational culture that supports equitable access to mentorship, professional development, and leadership opportunities. Our partnerships, standards, and research reflect our belief that ensuring broad participation in scientific leadership results in stronger, more impactful outcomes for global health.

USP is proud to be an equal employment opportunity employer (EEOE) and is committed to ensuring fair, merit-based selection processes that enable the best scientific minds—regardless of background—to contribute to advancing public health solutions worldwide. We provide reasonable accommodations to individuals with disabilities and uphold policies that create an inclusive and collaborative work environment.

**Brief Job Overview**

The Sales Effectiveness Director is a global commercial leadership role responsible for strengthening USP’s sales execution, productivity, and performance discipline across regions.

Based in India and reporting to the Vice President, Global Business Development, this role will partner closely with commercial leadership, regional sales teams as well as commercial support functions across USP to translate business objectives into practical sales strategies, scalable processes, and actionable performance insights.

You will lead global initiatives related to commercial strategy, sales enablement, CRM excellence, incentive governance, data analytics, and change management to help USP build a more consistent, accountable, and effective global sales organization.

The successful candidate will act as a change agent across the organization. He/ She/ They will be results driven, with a passion for building high-performance organizations, tools and processes.

We are searching for a person who wants to grow and develop his/her/their own career, a commercial leader with a passion for opening new doors and creating new opportunities.

This is a hybrid (3 days a week at the office) position based in USP office in Hyderabad, India that requires ability to travel internationally as requested.

**How will YOU create impact here at USP?**

**Standardized language for consistency (do not delete):**

As part of our mission to advance scientific rigor and public health standards, you will play a vital role in increasing global access to high-quality medicines through public standards and related programs. USP prioritizes scientific integrity, regulatory excellence, and evidence-based decision-making to ensure health systems worldwide can rely on strong, tested, and globally relevant quality standards.

Additionally, USP’s People and Culture division, in partnership with the Equity Office, invests in leadership and workforce development to equip all employees with the skills to create high-performing, inclusive teams. This includes training in equitable management practices and tools to promote engaged, collaborative, and results-driven work environments.

The Sales Effectiveness Director has the following responsibilities:

**Sales Strategy & Performance**

* Partner with Commercial Leadership to translate business objectives into actionable sales strategies and execution plans across regions.
* Define, monitor, and continuously improve key performance indicators to drive accountability, increase productivity, and support revenue growth.
* Lead sales forecasting, new business opportunities pipeline management, and performance analytics.

**Sales Enablement & Capability Building**

* Design and implement training programs for Strategic Customer Development and Inside Sales teams focused on consultative selling, scientific value articulation, new employee onboarding, and continuous development.
* Design and deploy global sales trainings that support consistent execution and stronger customer engagement.
* Ensure consistent use of sales methodologies and best practices globally.
* Partner with Marketing Operations to deploy effective messaging, value propositions, and customer engagement frameworks across regions.
* Drive adoption of best practices across regions and business units.

**Commercial Processes, Tools & CRM Excellence**

* Lead optimization and global adoption of CRM (Salesforce), ensuring data quality and actionable insights.
* Standardize, optimize, and monitor core commercial processes, including lead-to-opportunity management, opportunity tracking, account planning, and contract and proposal review and approval processes in close collaboration with Commercial and Marketing leadership and teams.
* Identify and deploy tools that enhance sales productivity and customer insights.
* Improve sales productivity through simplification, automation, and clear governance.

**Incentives, Governance & Sales Discipline**

* Design and manage incentive compensation frameworks aligned with growth priorities.
* Partner with Finance and HR to ensure transparency, fairness, and performance alignment.
* Support pricing, contracting, and large commercial proposal governance processes as needed.
* Reinforce a culture of accountability, compliance, and disciplined execution.

**Data, Analytics & Sales Insights**

* Leverage data, analytics, and tools to generate actionable commercial insights in support of regional or territory performance analysis and complex contract negotiations.
* Translate data into actionable insights to guide sales decisions, territory planning, and resource allocation.
* Support segmentation, targeting, and territory alignment strategies.
* Develop dashboards and reporting to provide real-time visibility to leadership.
* Identify performance gaps and implement targeted improvement initiatives.

**Global Alignment & Change Leadership**

* Drive consistency in sales execution while allowing for regional market nuances.
* Drive change management and adoption of new tools, processes, and ways of working.

**Note:**

As part of the recruitment process, USP's Global Talent Acquisition team may contact candidates through a variety of communication channels, including Microsoft Teams, telephone, email, and WhatsApp (voice calls and text messages). These communications may be used to schedule interviews, provide updates on application status, discuss career opportunities, and answer questions about employment with USP.

To help ensure timely communication, candidates are encouraged to keep their contact information current and to engage only with individuals who clearly identify themselves as authorized USP representatives. USP will never request payment, banking details, or other financial information as part of the hiring process.

**Fraud Alert:**

USP is committed to protecting job seekers from recruitment fraud. Legitimate employment-related communications will come only from authorized USP representatives. If you are unsure whether a communication is authentic, please verify it through USP’s official careers website before sharing personal information.

**Who is USP Looking For?**

The successful candidate will have a demonstrated understanding of our mission, commitment to excellence through inclusive and equitable behaviors and practices, ability to quickly build credibility with stakeholders, along with the below competencies and experience

Basic Qualifications:

* Minimum of 12+ years of experience in sales operations, commercial excellence, sales effectiveness, business analytics, or related commercial roles, preferably in the life sciences, pharmaceutical, biopharmaceutical, or healthcare industry.
* Master’s degree in business, economics, marketing, life sciences, or a related field required
* Ability to operate in full autonomy, with a hands-on, practical, and sales-first mindset while maintaining strong governance and compliance discipline.
* Experience developing dashboards, executive performance reviews, segmentation models, territory planning frameworks, or sales productivity tools.
* Excellent presentation and communication skills and experience with executive level interactions. Proficiency in English is required
* Demonstrated experience leading sales effectiveness programs, sales enablement, CRM adoption, forecasting, pipeline management, and performance analytics across regions and business units.
* Strong understanding of consultative selling, customer engagement, sales methodology deployment, and commercial process governance.
* Experience working with CRM and analytics platforms such as Salesforce, Power BI, Tableau, or similar tools.
* Proven ability to influence cross-functional stakeholders and drive adoption of new processes, tools, and ways of working in a matrixed global organization.
* Strong analytical, problem-solving, communication, and project management skills.
* Ability to translate data and business priorities into clear, actionable recommendations for commercial leadership.
* Ability to listen and gather customer/stakeholder insights and respond with creative solutions.
* Strong problem-solving skills
* Bias to action and results driven with a track record of successful outcomes.
* Excellent interpersonal skills, presentation, communications skills
* Ability and desire to work well with diverse employees and customers in a cooperative and friendly manner.

**Additional Desired Preferences**

* Education and training in pharmaceutical sciences and business highly desired.
* Familiarity with pharmaceutical, biopharmaceutical, reference standards, quality, regulatory, or experience working in Consulting firms serving Life Sciences industry.
* Experience supporting commercial teams across multiple geographies.
* Experience designing incentive compensation frameworks and partnering with Finance and HR on sales performance governance.

**Supervisory Responsibilities**

None, this is an individual contributor role.

**Benefits**

USP provides the benefits to protect yourself and your family today and tomorrow. From company-paid time off and comprehensive healthcare options to retirement savings, you can have peace of mind that your personal and financial well-being is protected.

Note: USP does not accept unsolicited resumes from 3rd party recruitment agencies and is not responsible for fees from recruiters or other agencies except under specific written agreement with USP.

description:
Job Description – Sales Manager

**Celes’tile Ceramics Pvt. Ltd. | Luxury Designer Tiles, Natural Stones & Interiors**

About the Company

Celes’tile Ceramics Pvt. Ltd. specializes in premium designer tiles, natural stones, stone cladding, metal art and luxury interior surface solutions. We cater to architects, interior designers, builders, developers, contractors and premium residential, commercial and hospitality projects.

We are seeking a results-driven **Sales Manager** responsible for revenue generation, monthly target achievement, lead conversion, team performance and business development across showroom, inside sales and project sales channels.

Position Details

* **Designation:** Sales Manager
* **Employment Type:** Full-Time
* **Work Location:** Shamshabad, Hyderabad, Telangana (Near KLCC Convention Centre)
* **Work Mode:** On-site
* **Experience:** Minimum 5 years in Sales / Sales Management, preferably in Tiles, Natural Stones, Building Materials, Luxury Interiors or Premium Retail.

Key Roles & Responsibilities1. Sales Strategy & Revenue Generation

* Develop and execute sales strategies to achieve monthly, quarterly and annual revenue targets.
* Take ownership of overall sales performance, revenue generation, order booking and business growth.
* Establish individual and team-wise monthly sales targets and monitor achievement against defined KPIs.
* Identify new revenue streams, market segments and opportunities to expand the company's customer base.
* Improve conversion rates, average order value, repeat business and customer retention.
* Monitor sales performance and implement corrective measures to address target shortfalls.

2. Lead Generation & Business Development

* Generate qualified leads through outbound calls, referrals, networking, market visits, digital enquiries and industry connections.
* Build and maintain a strong pipeline of prospective customers and project opportunities.
* Conduct regular follow-ups with prospective clients to convert enquiries into confirmed orders.
* Develop new business opportunities through architects, interior designers, builders, developers, contractors and channel partners.
* Maintain an updated database of prospects, enquiries, follow-ups, quotations and sales closures.
* Explore opportunities in residential, commercial, hospitality and large-scale interior projects.

3. Architect & Interior Designer Relationship Management

* Establish and maintain strong professional relationships with architects, interior designers, design consultants and project decision-makers.
* Conduct product presentations, showroom visits, design discussions and product demonstrations.
* Understand project specifications, design preferences, quantities, budgets and delivery requirements.
* Promote the company's premium tiles, natural stones, stone cladding and related product portfolio for project specifications.
* Develop long-term business relationships to secure repeat orders, referrals and project-based sales.
* Track upcoming projects and proactively engage stakeholders during the material selection and specification stages.

4. Inside Sales & Enquiry Management

* Supervise inside sales activities, including incoming enquiries, outbound calls, lead qualification and customer follow-ups.
* Ensure timely responses to enquiries received through calls, WhatsApp, email, website and other channels.
* Monitor the sales pipeline from initial enquiry through quotation, negotiation, order confirmation and handover.
* Ensure quotations are prepared accurately and followed up systematically until closure.
* Coordinate with the CRM team to maintain enquiry records, follow-up schedules and lead status updates.
* Improve lead response time, follow-up discipline and enquiry-to-order conversion.

5. Showroom & Project Sales

* Drive showroom walk-in conversions and project-based sales for premium tiles, natural stones and interior products.
* Understand customer requirements and recommend suitable products based on design, application, budget and project specifications.
* Manage pricing discussions, commercial negotiations, quotation finalisation and order closures within approved commercial policies.
* Coordinate with Operations, Warehouse, Installation and Finance teams for stock availability, delivery schedules, payment follow-ups and project execution.
* Ensure a professional customer experience throughout the sales cycle.

6. Sales Team Leadership & Performance Management

* Lead, guide and monitor the sales team to achieve individual and overall monthly targets.
* Allocate sales targets, territories, leads and customer accounts based on business priorities.
* Conduct regular performance reviews, pipeline reviews and sales meetings.
* Coach team members on product knowledge, lead generation, negotiation, customer engagement and closing techniques.
* Identify performance gaps and implement action plans to improve productivity and target achievement.
* Ensure accountability, timely reporting, disciplined follow-ups and professional conduct across the sales function.

7. Sales Reporting, MIS & CRM

* Prepare daily, weekly and monthly sales reports covering revenue, order bookings, enquiries, lead conversion, pending quotations and target achievement.
* Maintain accurate customer records, sales pipelines, forecasts and follow-up activities in the CRM system.
* Analyse sales trends, lost opportunities, customer feedback and reasons for non-conversion.
* Submit periodic performance updates and business forecasts to Management.
* Use sales data to identify growth opportunities and improve sales effectiveness.

8. Market Intelligence & Commercial Coordination

* Monitor competitor pricing, product launches, market demand and industry trends.
* Identify potential customers, new project locations and opportunities for market expansion.
* Coordinate with Marketing for campaigns, promotional activities, lead generation and customer engagement initiatives.
* Work closely with Finance on payment terms, outstanding collections and credit approvals within company policy.
* Ensure adherence to approved pricing, discount policies and commercial procedures.

Performance Expectations & KPIs

The Sales Manager will be evaluated on the following parameters:

* Achievement of assigned monthly, quarterly and annual revenue targets.
* Qualified lead generation and enquiry-to-order conversion ratio.
* New customer acquisition and architect/interior designer network development.
* Showroom sales, inside sales and project-sales performance.
* Value of confirmed orders and growth in repeat business.
* Sales pipeline health, quotation follow-ups and closure rates.
* Sales team productivity and individual target achievement.
* Accuracy and timeliness of CRM updates, MIS reports and sales forecasts.
* Customer satisfaction and coordination for timely order execution.

**Note:** Monthly revenue targets will be defined by Management based on business objectives, product categories, sales channels and market opportunities.

Qualifications & Skills

* Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Marketing, Sales or a related discipline preferred.
* Minimum 5 years of relevant sales experience, preferably with experience in sales management or team handling.
* Proven track record of revenue generation, lead conversion and achievement of sales targets.
* Experience in tiles, natural stones, architectural products, building materials, luxury interiors or premium retail will be preferred.
* Strong business development, negotiation, presentation and customer relationship management skills.
* Experience in inside sales, project sales, lead management and CRM systems.
* Proficiency in MS Excel, sales reporting and MIS.
* Strong communication skills and the ability to engage professionally with architects, interior designers, builders and premium customers.
* Willingness to travel locally for client meetings, project visits and business development.

Compensation

Compensation will be commensurate with experience, qualifications, sales achievements and overall suitability for the position. Plus incentives of 25000 Monthly Minimum

description:
Job Title: Business Development Officer – Healthcare & Medical Education (CPD Courses)

**Job Type:** Full-time  
**Work Mode:** Work from Office + Field Visits  
**Department:** Business Development & Institutional Sales  
**Experience Required:** 2–5 Years  
**Industry Preference:** Healthcare, Medical Education, Pharmaceutical Sales, Medical Training, or Institutional Business Development  
**Location:** Hyderabad, Telangana  
**Salary:** Competitive salary based on experience + Performance-Based Incentives

About the Role

We are looking for a dynamic, target-oriented, and experienced **Business Development Officer (BDO)** with a strong background in the medical and healthcare industry to drive business growth for our Continuing Professional Development (CPD) courses.

The ideal candidate should have prior experience in business development, institutional sales, healthcare partnerships, or medical education, with a proven ability to generate business from hospitals, clinics, medical colleges, nursing colleges, pharmacy colleges, and other healthcare-related institutions.

This is a field-oriented business development role that requires regular visits to healthcare institutions, building relationships with key decision-makers, promoting our CPD training programmes, developing institutional partnerships, and converting business opportunities into confirmed enrolments and revenue.

**We are specifically looking for someone who knows how to bring business to the company, has experience in the medical sector, and can independently develop new institutional accounts.**

Key Responsibilities1. Business Development & Revenue Generation

* Identify and develop new business opportunities for CPD courses and healthcare-related training programmes.
* Generate qualified leads and convert them into paying institutional clients and course enrolments.
* Develop and execute business development strategies to achieve monthly and quarterly revenue targets.
* Build a strong pipeline of hospitals, clinics, colleges, and healthcare institutions.
* Negotiate commercial terms, training packages, and institutional enrolment opportunities.
* Take ownership of the complete business development cycle, from prospecting to deal closure.

2. Hospital & Healthcare Institution Visits

* Conduct regular field visits to hospitals, clinics, diagnostic centres, healthcare groups, and other medical institutions.
* Meet hospital administrators, medical superintendents, HR managers, training coordinators, nursing superintendents, and other relevant decision-makers.
* Present CPD courses and explain their relevance to doctors, nurses, pharmacists, nutrition professionals, and other healthcare practitioners.
* Explore opportunities for institutional training programmes, bulk enrolments, staff development initiatives, and recurring training partnerships.
* Maintain consistent follow-ups with prospective and existing institutional clients to convert opportunities into business.

3. Medical College & Educational Institution Partnerships

* Develop business relationships with:
* MBBS colleges and medical schools
* Nursing colleges and nursing schools
* B.Sc. Nutrition and Dietetics colleges
* Pharmacy colleges
* Allied health sciences and paramedical institutions
* Healthcare training institutes and professional associations
* Visit college management teams, principals, deans, heads of departments, placement officers, and faculty coordinators.
* Promote CPD courses to relevant institutions and identify suitable opportunities for student, faculty, and professional enrolments, where applicable.
* Arrange institutional presentations, meetings, seminars, orientation sessions, and course awareness activities.
* Establish long-term partnerships with colleges and healthcare institutions to generate repeat business.

4. Institutional Sales & Partnership Development

* Pitch CPD programmes to hospitals, colleges, clinics, and healthcare organisations.
* Prepare proposals, quotations, presentations, and partnership offers for prospective clients.
* Explore bulk enrolment models, corporate training opportunities, institutional tie-ups, and customised training arrangements.
* Coordinate with internal teams to organise course demonstrations, information sessions, and enrolment drives.
* Identify new market segments and geographical areas for expanding the company's healthcare education business.

5. Lead Management & Client Relationship Management

* Maintain an updated database of prospects, institutional contacts, meetings, and sales opportunities.
* Track leads, follow-ups, proposals, negotiations, enrolments, and revenue generated.
* Use CRM tools or structured reporting systems to manage the sales pipeline.
* Maintain strong relationships with existing clients to encourage repeat enrolments and referrals.
* Submit daily activity reports and periodic business development reports to management.

6. Market Research & Competitor Analysis

* Research hospitals, medical colleges, nursing institutions, pharmacy colleges, and other potential clients.
* Identify institutions with suitable training requirements and potential demand for CPD courses.
* Monitor market trends, competitor offerings, and institutional training needs.
* Provide feedback to management regarding customer expectations, pricing opportunities, and potential new programmes.

Required Qualifications & Experience

* Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Marketing, Life Sciences, Pharmacy, Healthcare Management, Nursing, or a related discipline is preferred.
* **Minimum 2 years of relevant experience** in healthcare business development, pharmaceutical sales, medical education sales, institutional sales, or healthcare partnership development.
* Prior experience generating revenue or bringing business to a company within the medical or healthcare sector is essential.
* Experience dealing with hospitals, clinics, medical colleges, nursing colleges, pharmacy colleges, or healthcare institutions is strongly preferred.
* Demonstrated ability to identify prospects, meet decision-makers, develop relationships, negotiate, and close deals.
* Strong communication, presentation, negotiation, and relationship-management skills.
* Willingness to travel regularly for institutional visits and business meetings.
* Ability to work independently, manage a sales pipeline, and achieve assigned business targets.

Preferred Candidate Profile

The ideal candidate may have experience in one or more of the following areas:

* Pharmaceutical or medical product sales with strong institutional contacts.
* Hospital business development or corporate healthcare sales.
* Medical education, healthcare training, or CPD programme sales.
* Business development for nursing, pharmacy, allied health sciences, or medical colleges.
* Institutional partnerships, academic collaborations, or healthcare training contracts.
* Selling professional training programmes, certification courses, or educational services to healthcare organisations.

**Candidates with an existing network of hospital administrators, doctors, nursing college management, pharmacy college management, or medical education professionals will have an advantage.**

Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

Performance will be measured against clearly defined business development objectives, including:

* Number of new hospitals, clinics, and educational institutions approached.
* Number of qualified leads and decision-maker meetings generated.
* Number of institutional partnerships established.
* Number of proposals submitted and deals successfully closed.
* CPD course enrolments generated through institutional channels.
* Monthly and quarterly revenue achieved against assigned targets.
* Conversion rate from qualified leads to confirmed business.
* Quality of client relationships, follow-up discipline, and repeat business.

What We Offer

* Competitive salary based on experience and industry knowledge.
* Performance-based incentives linked to business generated.
* Opportunity to develop a strong network across the healthcare and medical education sectors.
* A growth-oriented role with direct responsibility for institutional partnerships and revenue generation.
* Opportunity to contribute to professional development and continuing education within the healthcare sector.
* Career growth opportunities based on performance and business impact.

How to Apply

Interested candidates who have relevant healthcare industry experience and a proven track record in business development are encouraged to apply.

Please highlight the following in your application:

* Previous healthcare or medical industry experience.
* Hospitals, clinics, colleges, or institutions handled.
* Experience in institutional sales and partnership development.
* Examples of business generated, sales targets achieved, or major accounts acquired.
* Current location, notice period, and expected salary.

**Important:** This is a business development and revenue-generation position, not a purely administrative or telecalling role. Candidates must be comfortable with field visits, institutional meetings, client relationship management, and achieving sales targets.

Pay: ₹40,000.00 - ₹50,000.00 per month

description:
**Skill:** Senior Architect- AI

**Exp:** 13 to 18 years

**Location**: Hyderabad

**Shift:** Flexible to work in Shifts

The Senior Architect in Delivery leads architecture and technical direction for multi-team Azure programs across applications, platforms, and data. You connect client goals to scalable designs, guide delivery across teams, and shape modernization work so it delivers measurable results.

At this level, you influence architecture beyond a single project. You set direction across engagements, work with business and technology leaders, raise the bar on delivery quality, and promote reusable patterns. You mentor architects and senior engineers, support strategic pursuits, and turn working solutions into repeatable delivery models.

***Responsibilities***

**Solution Architecture and Technical Leadership**

* Lead architecture and technical strategy for Azure modernization and transformation programs that span multiple teams and workstreams.
* Translate client goals into scalable designs that align with business priorities, non-functional requirements, delivery constraints, and program-level outcomes.
* Drive architecture across teams so designs follow shared models, standards, and patterns.
* Collaborate with architects and engineers in other domains to integrate solutions and maintain a cohesive end-to-end architecture.
* Provide ongoing architectural guidance during implementation, including reviews of key designs and code, and define patterns and guardrails that teams can reuse.
* Apply solid engineering practices in your primary domain—modular design, clear interfaces, testability, and observability—so solutions remain robust and maintainable.
* Use AI-assisted tooling to accelerate design, code, tests, documentation, and analysis, and help teams adopt effective practices at program scale.

***Delivery and Consulting Excellence***

* Lead or co-lead discovery and roadmap work for programs or large workstreams, turning inputs into integrated, testable backlogs with clear non-functional requirements and dependencies.
* Use structured problem solving to clarify scope, dependencies, and risks at program scale, and explain options in terms of value, cost, risk, and time-to-impact.
* Communicate architecture strategy and decisions clearly to technical and non-technical audiences, including executives.
* Build trusted relationships with product, engineering, and technology leaders, and help shape modernization roadmaps in the client’s best interest.
* Provide architecture oversight so designs, interfaces, and integration points support predictable delivery and stable team velocity.
* Align multiple teams on shared outcomes, contracts, and integration points, ensuring dependencies are identified, owned, and tracked through to delivery.
* Help define delivery approaches, working agreements, and documentation practices that keep 3Cloud and client teams aligned across locations and time zones.
* Support effective use of Agile at scale by ensuring architecture and backlog structure enable incremental delivery, clear definitions of done, and data-informed adjustments based on telemetry and feedback.
* Apply a consulting mindset by anticipating client needs, proposing options, and tying solutions to clear results and adoption, and handle challenge and pushback by explaining trade-offs in simple, direct language.
* Demonstrated ability to leverage AI and emerging technologies to improve productivity, enhance decision-making, streamline delivery processes, and drive measurable business value. Commitment to continuous learning and adoption of new digital capabilities is required.
* Proven success operating within large, matrixed consulting organizations and navigating the scale, complexity, governance, and pace of a Global System Integrator (GSI) environment. Ability to manage competing priorities, collaborate across cross-functional teams, and consistently deliver results in a fast-paced, performance-driven setting.

***Mentorship and Team Development***

* Mentor architects, senior engineers, and technical leads, building their design skills, architectural judgment, and ability to work effectively across systems and teams.
* Provide architectural oversight across teams or workstreams, modeling pragmatic decision-making and showing when to keep solutions simple and when new patterns or technologies are justified.
* Support hiring and growth by participating in technical interviews, calibration discussions, and mentorship, and by helping shape development plans for future architects.
* Growth and Innovation
* Contribute to business development by identifying opportunities beyond the current assignment across all our capabilities and assisting the sales director in pursuing them.
* Intentionally builds relationship networks within client accounts to deepen partnership and identify opportunities to provide additional business value.
* Partner with sales and account leaders on strategic pursuits by setting the technical vision, contributing to solution strategy, and participating in client workshops, demos, and roadmap sessions.
* Create solution options, high-level designs, and estimates for programs, clearly documenting assumptions, dependencies, and risks and tying them back to business value and risk reduction.
* Build and evolve reusable assets—such as reference architectures, runbooks, workshops, starter repositories, and templates—that become standard paths for delivery teams.
* Champion adoption of modern frameworks, patterns, platform capabilities, automation, and AI-assisted tools that improve quality, speed, or reliability in a safe and secure way.
* Actively participate in enablement initiatives, share lessons from complex engagements, and help build a culture of collaboration, continuous improvement, and knowledge sharing.

***Requirements***

* 10+ years of experience delivering solutions in a primary technical domain.
* 5+ years of experience in solution architecture and leading development or engineering teams, including multi-team or multi-workstream efforts.
* Deep expertise across most of the following:
* Agents & Orchestration – leveraging Semantic Kernel, LangChain, or similar frameworks to design intelligent workflows; applying tool/function calling, planner and agent-based patterns, and workflow automation engines.
* Search & Retrieval – implementing solutions with vector databases such as Azure AI Search, Pinecone, FAISS, or Milvus; applying hybrid search methods, re-ranking strategies, and selecting embedding models for accuracy and performance.
* Evaluation, Quality & LLM Operations – establishing offline and online evaluation approaches; using golden datasets, hallucination and groundedness validation, toxicity and safety testing; building telemetry and feedback loops; managing monitoring, deployment pipelines, and ongoing optimization of large language models.
* Responsible AI, Security & Privacy – incorporating practices such as threat modeling, privacy reviews, data minimization, safety guardrails, policy enforcement, auditability, and model risk management in line with GDPR and organizational standards.
* AI Platforms & Data Foundations – applying hands-on experience with Azure AI services, Databricks, Azure OpenAI, and related modern data platforms.
* Cloud Engineering – designing with APIs, containers, microservices, and DevOps pipelines to deliver scalable, cloud-native solutions.
* Data Integration & Governance – developing and managing data pipelines; applying quality controls, metadata practices, and master data management approaches.
* Analytics & Visualization – delivering insights with Power BI and other visualization tools.
* Proficiency with modern development tools (e.g., GitHub, Copilot, Cursor).
* Knowledge of analytics and data science tools, frameworks, and advanced techniques.
* Relevant Azure or Databricks certifications in AI, Data, or Architecture.
* Proven experience leading architecture and delivery for Azure-based solutions such as modernizations, transformations, or platform build-outs.
* Ability to define solution architectures that connect business goals to scalable technical designs and solid delivery practices.
* Experience leading hybrid and remote teams and maintaining alignment, quality, and predictable delivery across time zones.
* Deep knowledge of core concepts, languages, frameworks, and design patterns in your primary domain, with the ability to apply them at program scale.
* Experience using AI-augmented development and integrating AI or machine learning capabilities into solutions using APIs, frameworks, or cloud-based AI services.
* Experience with Agile or Scrum at scale, including backlog management, work slicing, and dependency handling.
* Experience in consulting or professional services.
* Familiarity with key Azure services relevant to your domain, such as messaging, compute, data, security, networking, and integration.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with clear written and verbal communication.

* Ability to stay hands-on with architecture and, when needed, implementation while guiding complex cloud solutions across teams.

**Director, Product Management**
================================

**Director, Product Management — Learning**

**About Cornerstone:**

Cornerstone powers the future of work by helping organizations develop, engage, and grow their people. Our learning and talent platform serves thousands of organizations and millions of learners worldwide, bringing together learning experiences, skills intelligence, content, and analytics so people can build the capabilities their organizations need most. We are investing heavily in the next generation of learning — including AI-assisted, skills-based, and outcome-driven experiences — and we are looking for product leaders who can turn that ambition into products customers love.

**About the Role:**

Cornerstone is seeking a Director of Product Management to lead a core area of our Learning product line. This is a senior product leadership role that combines product vision and strategy, people leadership, and disciplined execution. You will own the strategy and roadmap for your area, lead and grow a team of product managers, and be accountable for delivering learning experiences that drive measurable adoption, learner and administrator value, and commercial impact.

You will partner across engineering, design, data science, content, customer success, services, sales, and marketing to move capabilities from customer need through discovery, launch, adoption, and outcome realization. The ideal candidate brings deep enterprise SaaS product experience, a strong track record building products that customers adopt and love, and the judgment to balance long-term platform strategy with the operational rigor required to ship. Experience with AI-native and skills-based capabilities is a strong plus — AI is an increasingly central theme across the Learning portfolio.

**In this role you will...**

**Set vision & strategy**

* Own the product vision and multi-year roadmap for your area of the Learning portfolio, grounded in market trends, customer needs, and Cornerstone's strategy.
* Make and defend prioritization decisions with clear rationale, translating strategy into a sequenced roadmap and well-formed bets.
* Frame the business case for major investments — market sizing, opportunity, and expected outcomes — and align leadership and cross-functional partners behind it.
* Champion AI and skills-based innovation where it creates real learner and administrator value, integrating intelligent capabilities responsibly into the learning experience.

**Lead & grow the team**

* Hire, coach, and develop a team of product managers, setting a high bar for product craft, customer empathy, and accountability.
* Establish product standards and operating cadences for discovery, planning, release, and outcome review across your team.
* Create clarity and alignment across product, engineering, and design leadership, and represent your area to executives and customers.

**Discover, experiment & measure**

* Drive rigorous customer discovery, engaging directly with enterprise customers, learners, and administrators to validate problems and use cases before committing to solutions.
* Run a hypothesis-driven practice — define success metrics, instrument products, and use experimentation and A/B testing to learn quickly and de-risk decisions.
* Define and own the success metrics and North Star for your area (adoption, engagement, retention, time-to-value, and business outcomes), and use them to guide investment.
* Translate customer, field, and market feedback into clear requirements, prioritized backlogs, and release plans.

**Deliver with rigor**

* Drive cross-functional delivery across product, engineering, design, data science, content, customer success, services, and go-to-market teams.
* Establish strong operating cadences for milestone reviews, dependency management, risk tracking, and outcome measurement, surfacing risks early.
* Partner with go-to-market and customer-facing teams on rollout planning, launch enablement, implementation readiness, and feedback loops.
* Ensure capabilities are scalable, secure, compliant, and practical for adoption in enterprise environments, meeting expectations for security, privacy, and data governance.

**What Success Looks Like:**

* A clear, well-communicated vision and roadmap that leadership, customers, and the team understand and rally behind.
* A high-performing product team that ships quality work on a predictable cadence and grows in capability.
    
  Products that customers adopt and love — reflected in faster time-to-value, stronger engagement and retention, anD measurable business outcomes.
* Decisions grounded in evidence from discovery, experimentation, and metrics rather than opinion alone.
* AI-assisted and skills-based capabilities launched in ways that are trusted, usable, and outcome-oriented.
* Security, compliance, and data governance requirements embedded into delivery from the start.

**You've got what it takes if you have…**

* 10+ years in product management, including experience leading product managers, in enterprise software, SaaS, or platform organizations.
* A track record of owning product vision and strategy for a product area and translating it into roadmaps that ship and drive outcomes.
* Demonstrated people leadership — hiring, coaching, and growing product managers and setting team standards.
* Strong discovery and experimentation skills: customer research, hypothesis-driven development, metrics definition, and A/B testing.
* Proven ability to lead execution across complex cross-functional organizations with operational rigor and release discipline.
* Excellent collaboration and communication skills across engineering, UX, data science, services, sales, support, and customer success, up to the executive level.
* Experience delivering products in secure, enterprise-grade environments where trust, reliability, and scalability matter, including familiarity with security, privacy, and data governance.

**Nice to Have:**

* Experience in learning, HR technology, talent management, or skills/EdTech domains.
* Experience delivering AI-native products, intelligent agents, copilots, automation, or workflow-based AI in enterprise settings.
* Experience with skills-based capabilities, content ecosystems, or analytics/insights products.

Where curious disruptors and change innovators like you are helping communities and customers enable everyone – anywhere – to learn, grow and advance. To be better tomorrow than they are today.

description:
Business Introduction GSK remains committed to achieving bold commercial ambitions for the future. By 2031, we aim to deliver £40 billion in annual sales, leveraging our existing strong performance momentum to significantly increase our positive impact on the health of billions of patients globally. Through continuous innovation and a dedicated focus on scientific and technical excellence, we strive to develop and launch new, groundbreaking treatments that address critical health challenges. Position Summary You will lead commercial activities in Hyderabad to grow the business and support better patient care. You will work closely with field colleagues and cross-functional partners to create and deliver clear territory plans. Building trusted relationships with healthcare professionals and contributing practical insights from the field will shape local strategy. We seek people who are curious, collaborative, and eager to learn. This role offers meaningful growth, the chance to make a real impact, and aligns with our mission of uniting science, technology and talent to get ahead of disease together. Why You? This role is hybrid, combining fieldwork with time at the Hyderabad office. You will travel regularly within the assigned territory. You will join a supportive team that invests in your development through coaching, practical experience, and clear goals. We seek people who act with integrity, prioritize patients, and work well with others. From day one, you will have meaningful responsibility and visible career pathways. We encourage applicants who value inclusion to apply and grow with us. Basic Qualification We are seeking professionals with the following required skills and qualifications to help us achieve our goals: - Bachelor’s degree in life sciences, pharmacy, nursing, business, or related fields. - At least one year of experience in a customer-facing role; experience in healthcare or pharmaceuticals preferred. - Strong verbal and written communication skills in English. Proficiency in Telugu or Hindi is an advantage. - Demonstrated ability to build professional relationships and influence healthcare stakeholders. - Comfortable using common digital tools such as Word and Excel, and willing to learn CRM and other platforms. - Willingness to work in a hybrid setting, travel regularly within the assigned territory, and represent the company professionally. Location and Working Pattern This role is based in Hyderabad, India. The working pattern is hybrid, with regular travel within the assigned territory. We welcome applicants from all backgrounds and encourage people who value inclusion to apply. We look forward to hearing how you can grow your career with us and help improve patient care.

Customer Centric Selling, Data to Insights, Digital Fluency, Omnichannel, Sales Territory Management, Scientific Literacy

GSK is a global biopharma company with a purpose to unite science, technology and talent to get ahead of disease together. We aim to positively impact the health of 2.5 billion people by the end of the decade, as a successful, growing company where people can thrive. We get ahead of disease by preventing and treating it with innovation in specialty medicines and vaccines. People and patients around the world count on the medicines and vaccines we make, so we’re committed to creating an environment where our people can thrive and focus on what matters most. About the Role

Dr. Cure Pharmacy Group (Cureaxis Health Pvt Ltd) operates 7 retail pharmacy stores across Greater Hyderabad and a central warehouse. Dr Cure is not a conventiona Pharmacy chain, we are beyond Pharmacy.

We are looking for a person who owns the entire administrative and financial backbone of the business — payroll, attendance, GST coordination, vendor documentation, and the hiring pipeline.

We are looking for talent who can build systems, not just running them.

Key Responsibilities — Managerial Accounting

1. GST Coordination

* Compile monthly purchase and sales data across all 7 stores and the warehouse.
* Ensure all supporting documents are accurate and properly organised.
* Share the compiled documentation with the Chartered Accountant (CA) by the 5th of every month.

2. Purchase Reconciliation

* Match distributor invoices against Goods Receipt Note (GRN) entries in the system.
* Identify and flag discrepancies before processing payments.
* Coordinate with the relevant teams and vendors to resolve mismatches.

3. Vendor Payment Tracking

* Maintain a vendor-wise tracker of outstanding payables.
* Monitor payment due dates and pending liabilities.
* Alert management in advance of upcoming payment deadlines.

4. Petty Cash Management

* Maintain store-wise petty cash records.
* Collect and verify expense vouchers from store managers every week.
* Ensure expenses are properly documented and accounted for.

5. Monthly Profit & Loss (P&L) Inputs

* Compile monthly revenue and expense figures for each store.
* Ensure the data is accurate and supported by relevant records.
* Prepare and share the information with the CA for review and monthly P&L preparation.

6. TDS Compliance Coordination

* Track applicable Tax Deducted at Source (TDS) deductions on vendor payments.
* Maintain records of TDS deductions and related transactions.
* Coordinate with the CA for timely filing and compliance.

7. Audit Documentation

* Maintain an organised repository of invoices, receipts, agreements, and statutory filings.
* Ensure documents are properly classified and easily accessible.
* Retrieve and provide any requested document within 10 minutes.

8. Bank Reconciliation

* Reconcile monthly bank statements against accounting system records.
* Identify and investigate discrepancies.
* Escalate significant mismatches to management immediately.

9. Financial Reporting and Analysis

* Generate monthly financial reports.
* Analyse revenue, expenses, and other key financial indicators.
* Share financial reports and relevant insights with management to support decision-making.

Key Responsibilities — HR & Administration1. Payroll Processing

* Process payroll for all stores by the 28th of every month.
* Account for salary advances, deductions, arrears, and other payroll adjustments.
* Ensure payroll records are accurate and properly maintained.

2. Attendance Management

* Maintain attendance records across all stores.
* Coordinate with store managers to verify and close attendance by the 25th of every month.
* Resolve attendance discrepancies before payroll processing.

3. Employee Onboarding

* Issue offer letters to selected candidates.
* Collect and verify joining documents.
* Coordinate bank account opening and complete PF/ESI registration for new employees, as applicable.

4. Hiring and Recruitment Coordination

* Post job openings across relevant recruitment channels.
* Screen applications and shortlist suitable candidates.
* Schedule interviews and maintain a candidate pipeline tracker.
* Coordinate the complete recruitment process, from job posting to candidate joining.

5. Employee Documentation

* Maintain complete and updated employee files for all active employees.
* Ensure records include employment agreements, identity proofs, nominee details, PF numbers, and other relevant documents.
* Keep employee records organised, confidential, and readily accessible.

6. PF & ESI Compliance

* Coordinate timely filing and payment of monthly PF and ESI contributions.
* Work with the CA to ensure statutory compliance.
* Address employee queries related to PF, ESI, and associated benefits.

7. Employee Exit Formalities

* Coordinate employee separation and exit procedures.
* Process full-and-final settlements within the required timelines.
* Collect company assets and ensure the completion of exit documentation.
* Issue relieving letters and other required documents on time.

8. Vendor and Contract Administration

* Maintain records of vendor agreements, Annual Maintenance Contracts (AMCs), and lease documents.
* Track contract validity periods and renewal dates.
* Send advance reminders to management regarding upcoming renewals and expiries.

9. Day-to-Day Administration

* Manage office supplies and general administrative requirements.
* Coordinate store repairs, maintenance requests, and facility-related issues.
* Liaise with service vendors to ensure timely resolution of operational requirements.

**Who We Are Looking ForNon-negotiable**

* 2–4 years of experience in accounts + admin or HR + admin in a small or mid-size company (not a large MNC where each function is siloed — we need someone who has held both)
* Proficient in Tally or any standard accounting software
* Excellent knowledge and working experience on Microsoft Excel
* Speaks and writes Telugu and English fluently; Hindi is a plus
* Understands GST basics well enough to compile documentation without hand-holding
* Comfortable with ambiguity — some processes do not exist yet; you will build them
* Highly organised, detail-oriented, and trustworthy with confidential financial and employee data
* Must be based in Hyderabad and able to commute to our office daily (this is a full-time, in-office role)

**Strongly preferred**

* Prior experience in retail, pharmacy, or healthcare back-office
* Familiarity with PF/ESI portal and basic compliance filings
* Has worked in a company that was actively growing when they joined — they know what it feels like to build while running

* Someone who needs a fully defined SOP for everything before they act

  + Define product requirements and design needs by displaying complete understanding of product vision and business requirements

    - Validate the solution/ prototype from technology, cost structure and customer differentiation point of view
    - Identify problem areas and perform root cause analysis of architectural design and solutions and provide relevant solutions to the problem
    - Tracks industry and application trends and relates these to planning current and future IT needs
  + Provides technical and strategic input during the product deployment at the client site

  + Identify technical, process, structural risks and prepare a risk mitigation plan for the product

  + Leads the development and maintenance of enterprise framework and related artefacts
  + Develops trust and builds effective working relationships through respectful, collaborative engagement across individual product teams
  + Ensure optimal Client Engagement
    - Support pre-sales team while presenting the entire product design and its principles to the client
    - Negotiate, manage and coordinate with the client teams to ensure all requirements are met and create an impact of solution proposed
    - Demonstrate thought leadership with strong technical capability in front of the client to win the confidence and act as a trusted advisor

  + Ensure completion of necessary trainings and certifications
  + Develop Proof of Concepts (POCs),case studies, demos etc. for new growth areas based on market and customer research
  + Develop and present a point of view of Wipro on product design and architect by writing white papers, blogs etc.
  + Attain market referencability and recognition through highest analyst rankings, client testimonials and partner credits
  + Be the voice of Wipro s Thought Leadership by speaking in forums (internal and external)
  + Mentor developers, designers and Junior architects for their further career development and enhancement
  + Contribute to the architecture practice by conducting selection interviews etc
* **Team Management**
  + Resourcing
    - Anticipating new talent requirements as per the market/ industry trends or client requirements
    - Hire adequate and right resources for the team
  + Talent Management
    - Ensure adequate onboarding and training for the team members to enhance capability & effectiveness
    - Build an internal talent pool and ensure their career progression within the organization
    - Manage team attrition
    - Drive diversity in leadership positions
  + Performance Management
    - Set goals for the team, conduct timely performance reviews and provide constructive feedback to own direct reports
    - Ensure that the Performance Nxt is followed for the entire team
  + Employee Satisfaction and Engagement
    - Lead and drive engagement initiatives for the team
    - Track team satisfaction scores and identify initiatives to build engagement within the team

-----

No.

* **Market Intelligence:** Track competitor activities, new project launches, market trends, and developer offerings to identify growth opportunities.
* **Sales Reporting:** Maintain accurate records of leads, meetings, negotiations, onboarding progress, and closures in the company’s CRM.
* **Target Achievement:** Meet monthly and quarterly targets for developer acquisition, partnership closures, client closures and business revenue.

Requirements

* Bachelor’s degree in Business Administration, Marketing, Sales, or a related field.

* Number of developers successfully onboarded.

* Revenue and business opportunities generated through developer partnerships.

* Opportunity to build and expand a strong developer network and client base.

description:
**Company:** Natural Power Asia Pvt. Ltd.  
**Industry:** Solar Energy / Solar EPC  
**Location:** Banjara Hills, Hyderabad  
**Department:** Sales & Business Development  
**Position:** Solar Channel Partner Executive  
**Experience:** 0–3 Years  
**Salary:** ₹10,000–₹20,000 per month + performance-based incentives  
**Working Days:** 6 days per week  
**Working Hours:** 9:30 AM to 6:30 PM

Job Summary

Natural Power Asia Pvt. Ltd. is looking for a proactive and target-oriented Solar Channel Partner Executive to develop, onboard, and manage a network of channel partners for our solar EPC business. The candidate will be responsible for partner acquisition, business development, lead generation, sales coordination, and maintaining long-term relationships with partners to increase the company's solar project business.

Key Responsibilities

**1. Channel Partner Acquisition**

* Identify and approach potential solar channel partners across Telangana and other regions of India.
* Connect with electrical shops, solar dealers, electricians, solar installers, builders, architects, contractors, consultants, and business entrepreneurs.
* Explain the company's solar EPC services, partnership opportunities, business model, and earning potential.
* Generate leads through telephone calls, WhatsApp, social media, email, referrals, and direct meetings.
* Register new channel partners and maintain their details in the company database.

**2. Partner Onboarding and Relationship Management**

* Guide new partners through the registration and onboarding process.
* Share company profiles, product information, service details, marketing materials, and partnership guidelines.
* Maintain regular communication with existing partners and encourage them to generate business.
* Conduct follow-ups, online meetings, and partner training sessions whenever required.
* Resolve partner queries by coordinating with the concerned internal departments.

**3. Lead Management and Sales Coordination**

* Collect customer enquiries and project leads from channel partners.
* Record and track leads in Excel or the company's CRM system.
* Coordinate with the sales and technical teams for site surveys, quotations, pricing, and project feasibility.
* Follow up on quotations and ensure timely communication with partners.
* Track each lead from initial enquiry to order confirmation and project execution.

**4. Business Development and Performance Monitoring**

* Work towards monthly targets for new partner acquisition, active partners, qualified leads, and project conversions.
* Identify opportunities to expand the company's channel partner network.
* Monitor partner performance and prepare regular reports on leads, enquiries, quotations, and orders.
* Suggest strategies to improve partner engagement and business generation.

**5. Reporting and Coordination**

* Maintain an updated channel partner database with contact details, location, business type, and lead status.
* Submit daily activity reports and weekly performance reports to the reporting manager.
* Coordinate with sales, engineering, procurement, marketing, and project execution teams.
* Ensure all partner communications and commercial commitments follow company policies.

Eligibility Criteria

* Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Marketing, Commerce, Engineering, or a related field.
* 0–3 years of experience in channel sales, business development, dealer management, or solar sales.
* Solar EPC, renewable energy, electrical products, or distributor network experience will be preferred.
* Good communication, negotiation, presentation, and follow-up skills.
* Knowledge of MS Excel, email, WhatsApp Business, and basic CRM operations.
* Ability to work with sales targets and develop long-term business relationships.
* Willingness to travel for partner meetings when required.

Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

* Number of new channel partners onboarded.
* Number of active partners generating enquiries.
* Qualified leads received from partners.
* Quotations and orders generated through the partner network.
* Revenue and project conversions from channel partners.
* Partner engagement, follow-up quality, and reporting accuracy.

Compensation and Benefits

* Monthly salary based on experience and suitability.
* Performance-based incentives linked to company-approved targets.
* Opportunities for career growth in solar channel sales and business development.

**Interested candidates may share their updated resume on hr@naturalpower.in**

Pay: ₹10,000.00 - ₹20,000.00 per month

**About Us:**

At **Zithara.ai**, we are pioneering the next generation of **Customer Intelligence**. Our platform serves as the "North Star" for consumer brands, empowering them to unify disparate customer data, automate personalized omnichannel engagement, and deploy advanced AI Agents for sales, support, and marketing. From unearthing deep analytics to operationalizing AI for conversion, Zithara.ai simplifies retention and accelerates revenue growth for high-transaction, data-rich industries.

**The Role:**

We are looking for a tenacious, tech-savvy, and highly-motivated **Sales Development Representative (SDR)** to join our rapidly growing sales team **based out of our Hyderabad office**.

Your primary objective will be to identify, prospect, and qualify high-potential accounts within major **Retail, E-commerce, and Customer-Facing Businesses** across **India and Australia**.

You will be engaging with senior decision-makers (Chief Growth Officers, VP of Marketing, CX Directors) in organizations where customer data is vast but often siloed. To succeed, you must manage your time effectively across different time zones and articulate how Zithara.ai solves complex challenges like customer churn, increasing Customer Acquisition Cost (CAC), and the need for AI-driven personalization at scale.

**Key Responsibilities:**

* **Strategic Outbound Prospecting:** Build, research, and segment target lists of enterprise and mid-market accounts within Retail, E-commerce, QSR, Hospitality, and consumer-facing BFSI sectors across the India and Australia regions.
* **Multi-Channel Outreach & Time Zone Management:** Execute coordinated outreach cadences using a strategic mix of personalised emails, social selling (LinkedIn), and confident cold calling. *You will need to align your working hours effectively to maximize engagement in both the Indian and Australian business days.*
* **Value-Based Conversations:** Engage with senior retail leaders to discuss their business-level metrics (conversion rate, average order value, repeat purchase rate) and introduce Zithara.ai as the strategic solution.
* **Lead Qualification:** Meticulously qualify inbound leads and prospect-initiated interest, ensuring every meeting booked for our Account Executives (AEs) meets strict definition of qualification (pain, authority, need, and timeline).
* **A/B Testing & Optimization:** Continuously test and optimize email subject lines, call scripts, and LinkedIn outreach messaging to maximize engagement and conversion rates in different regional markets.
* **CRM Discipline:** Document all sales activities, contacts, and opportunity data meticulously in our CRM ([Insert CRM Name, e.g., HubSpot/Salesforce]).
* **Collaboration:** Partner closely with Marketing to refine messaging for the retail sector and with AEs to ensure seamless handoffs and high-quality meetings.

**Qualifications:**

* **Experience:** 1–3 years of outbound sales development or lead generation experience in B2B SaaS. *Exposure to the Retail or E-commerce technology landscape is a significant advantage.*
* **Communication Skills:** Exceptional verbal and written English communication skills. You must write compelling, differentiated emails and be comfortable navigating objection-heavy phone conversations with C-level executives.
* **Time Zone Flexibility:** Proven ability to manage work hours effectively to cover early morning or late evening shifts required for the Australian market (AEST/AWST) and regular Indian business hours (IST).
* **Tech Stack Proficiency:** Skilled use of the modern sales stack (e.g., LinkedIn Sales Navigator, Outreach, Salesforce, ZoomInfo, Apollo.io, or equivalent tools).
* **Resilience & Performance Mindset:** Unwavering positivity, a high rejection tolerance, and a proven track record of meeting or exceeding performance quotas (pipeline generation).
* **Location:** Residing in or willing to relocate to Hyderabad, India.

**What to Expect (Why Join Us):**

* **High-Demand Technology:** You will sell an AI solution that solves the #1 challenge for retailers today: how to understand and retain customers in a noisy market.
* **Impact on Dynamic Markets:** Own and grow two of the most significant and rapidly evolving retail markets globally.
* **Accelerated Career Growth:** We prioritize promoting from within. Success in this role leads directly to senior Account Executive, Account Manager, or Sales Ops leadership opportunities.
* **Robust Training:** Hands-on training from experienced SaaS leaders covering advanced sales methodologies, product mastery, and vertical-specific strategies.
* **Competitive Compensation:** A strong base salary plus an uncapped commission structure that rewards high output and quality leads.

Zithara.ai is an equal opportunity employer and values diversity at our company.

title: Business Development Representative
description:
**Opportunity Overview:**

We are seeking a **Business Development Representative (BDR)** to join our Growth team. In this role, you will be responsible for identifying and engaging prospective healthcare payer customers, generating qualified meetings, and helping build a strong sales pipeline for our commercial organization. You'll partner closely with Sales Executives, Marketing, and Sales Operations to execute targeted outbound campaigns and connect prospective customers with Cohere's innovative healthcare solutions. This is an excellent opportunity for someone who enjoys building relationships, solving problems, and developing a successful career in enterprise software sales.

**What you'll do:**

* Generate qualified meetings through strategic outbound prospecting using email, phone, LinkedIn, and other approved channels.
* Research healthcare payer organizations and identify key decision-makers, buying committees, and executive stakeholders.
* Build account plans and maintain accurate prospect and opportunity information within Salesforce.
* Partner with Sales Executives to develop strategic outreach plans for target accounts and ensure a seamless handoff of qualified opportunities.
* Qualify inbound and outbound opportunities using established sales qualification criteria.
* Develop a strong understanding of Cohere's products, value proposition, and the healthcare payer market to effectively communicate how our solutions address customer challenges.
* Collaborate with Marketing to provide feedback on campaign effectiveness, lead quality, messaging, and target accounts.
* Support industry conferences, customer events, meeting coordination, and follow-up activities.
* Contribute to the development and continuous improvement of outreach messaging, sales cadences, account research, and prospecting best practices.
* Maintain high-quality CRM data while consistently meeting activity, pipeline, and meeting generation goals.

**ISMS roles and responsibilities**

* Fair understanding of Information Security practices.
* Align to the organization policies and procedures.
* Ensure to get updated with ISMS roles as assigned by the department/process heads.

**Required Qualifications:**

**Must-Haves**

* 2–4 years of experience in Business Development, Sales Development, Lead Generation, or inside sales.
* Experience selling SaaS or healthcare technology solutions.
* Demonstrated success meeting or exceeding prospecting or pipeline generation goals.
* Strong written and verbal English communication skills.
* Excellent organizational and time management skills.
* Ability to research complex organizations and identify executive stakeholders.
* Experience using Salesforce or another CRM platform.
* Experience using LinkedIn Sales Navigator, ZoomInfo, or similar prospecting tools.
* Strong curiosity, resilience, and a proactive approach to problem-solving.

**Nice-to-Haves**

* Knowledge of the healthcare payer market.
* Familiarity with MEDDPICC, Command of the Message, or similar value selling and consultative sales methodologies.
* Familiarity with AI tools to improve research, prospecting, and productivity.

**Ability to commute/relocate:**

* Hyderabad, Telangana: Reliably commute or planning to relocate before starting work (Preferred)

**Interview Process\*:**

* Connect with Talent Acquisition

* Meet with the Hiring Manager

* Behavioral Interview(s)

* Case Study

* Interview with Senior Leadership

* Subject to change

**About Cohere Health:**

Cohere Health's clinical intelligence platform and agentic AI-powered solutions connect health plans' strategic goals and providers' needs, optimizing the speed, cost, and quality of care. With an enterprise approach that streamlines payer-provider decision-making across the care continuum–including policy, prior authorization, payment accuracy, and more–the company improves collaboration and reduces burden, resulting in up to 8x ROI and 94% provider satisfaction.

With the acquisition of ZignaAI, we expanded our AI-native platform with a comprehensive Payment Integrity Suite that spans data mining, clinical and coding validation, authorization and claims reconciliation, and end-to-end payment integrity services across pre- and post-pay workflows. By connecting clinical and payment insights, our transparent, AI-powered solutions help health plans proactively improve payment accuracy, reduce waste and vendor dependency, strengthen provider relationships, and build smarter, more efficient payment integrity programs.

Cohere Health's innovations continue to receive industry-wide recognition. We've been recognized on TIME's World Top HealthTech Companies 2025 list, the 2025 Inc. 5000 list, in the Gartner® Hype Cycle™ for U.S. Healthcare Payers (2022-2025), and ranked as a Top 5 LinkedIn™ Startup for 2023 & 2024.

**We can't wait to learn more about you and meet you at Cohere Health!**

Cohere Health is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We are committed to fostering an environment of mutual respect where equal employment opportunities are available to all. To us, it's personal.

#### **Job Description:**

Position Title: Head of Sales – Hyderabad Region

Company: Della Townships India (Della Group)

Project: Della International City, Hyderabad

Project Scale: ~1,750 to 2,000 Acres | Projected GDV ₹20,000+ Crore

Location: Hyderabad, Telangana

Reporting To: Chief Executive Officer / Founder & Chairman (Jimmy Mistry)

Job Overview

Della Townships is seeking an exceptional, high-energy Head of Sales to establish, build, and lead our new regional sales office in Hyderabad. This leadership role will take complete end-to-end P&L ownership of the go-to-market strategy, launch, and sales execution for Della International City, Hyderabad—a landmark ~2,000-acre mega luxury integrated township.

The project features an unprecedented mix of luxury private villas, branded sky residences, international golf and motorsport estate homes, luxury retail design districts, 5-star resorts, and prime commercial premises. The Head of Sales will build a top-tier sales organization from scratch, establish distribution channels across High-Net-Worth Individuals (HNIs), Ultra-HNIs, NRIs, and global corporate clients, and drive revenues for one of India's most ambitious real estate developments.

Key Responsibilities

1. Setup & Operationalization of Hyderabad Sales Office

Establish the regional sales headquarters in Hyderabad from ground zero, including infrastructure setup, operational workflows, and team structuring.
  
Hire, mentor, and lead a high-performing team of Sourcing Managers, Closing Managers, HNI/NRI Relationship Managers, Channel Partner Leads, and Commercial Leasing/Sales Directors.
  
Build a high-accountability sales culture aligned with Della’s luxury hospitality, design excellence, and customer-first values.
  
2. Strategic Sales Planning & Revenue Ownership

Formulate and execute a aggressive, multi-phase sales strategy for a ₹20,000+ Cr GDV pipeline spanning:
  
Ultra-Luxury Private Villas & Branded Residences
  
Golf & Racing Estate Plots
  
Commercial Premises & GCC/Corporate Hubs
  
Hospitality & Experiential Real Estate Products
  
Design dynamic pricing frameworks, payment plans, and inventory release strategies to maximize yields across market cycles.

3. Channel Partner & Ecosystem Development

Map, onboard, and manage tier-1 national and regional real estate IPCs (Jones Lang LaSalle, CBRE, Knight Frank, Cushman & Wakefield) alongside top local channel partners in South India.
  
Establish strategic relationships with private wealth managers, family offices, wealth advisory firms, and luxury lifestyle concierges catering to UHNI/HNI segments.
  
4. International & NRI Sales Expansion

Drive offshore outreach programs targeting NRIs and global investors across the GCC/Middle East, US, UK, and South East Asia.
  
Organize high-net-worth investor meets, roadshows, and private showcase events in key international wealth centers.
  
5. Cross-Functional Alignment & Customer Experience

Work closely with Central Marketing to align performance marketing, brand campaigns, and PR with sales lead generation pipelines.
  
Collaborate with project management and legal teams to ensure seamless customer journeys—from booking, agreement execution, and customer onboarding to site visits.
  
Leverage tech-enabled sales enablement platforms, CRM systems, and virtual visualization tools to offer an immersive buying experience.
  
Required Experience & Key Skills

Overall Experience: 10- 15 Years in real estate sales, with at least 8–10 years in senior sales leadership roles (VP Sales, Business Head, or Regional Sales Head).
  
Luxury & Scale Track Record: Proven track record of managing multi-billion rupee luxury real estate launches, township projects, or high-end residential/commercial portfolios in South India (Hyderabad market expertise strongly preferred).
  
Network & Relationships: Deep, established networks with top-tier IPCs, regional wealth advisors, family offices, and HNI networks in Telangana and Andhra Pradesh.
  
Leadership Capabilities: Demonstrated capability to set up regional business units from scratch, scale headcount, and manage complex cross-functional teams.
