title: Senior CRM Manager – Real Estate
description:
JOB DESCRIPTION: **Senior CRM – Real Estate (Pre-Sales & Post-Sales)**

**Company:** Profound Group  
**Department:** Customer Relationship Management (CRM)  
**Designation:** Senior CRM / Senior Customer Relationship Manager  
**Experience:** 8+ Years  
**Industry:** Real Estate – Residential Apartments, Luxury Villas & Commercial Properties  
**Work Location:** Kondapur, Hyderabad, Telangana  
**Working Days:** Monday to Saturday  
**Employment Type:** Full-Time

**1. Job Purpose**: We are looking for an experienced and result-oriented **Senior CRM professional** to lead and manage the complete customer lifecycle, covering both pre-sales coordination and post-sales operations across residential apartments, premium villas, and commercial real estate projects.

The ideal candidate must possess strong expertise in customer relationship management, sales coordination, Agreement of Sale (AoS) preparation and execution, documentation, payment follow-ups, registration coordination, possession management, and customer grievance resolution.

The candidate will be responsible for ensuring a seamless customer journey from the initial enquiry and booking stage through agreement execution, construction updates, registration, property handover, and post-possession support, while maintaining regulatory compliance, documentation accuracy, customer satisfaction, and operational efficiency.

**2. Key Roles & ResponsibilitiesA. Pre-Sales CRM & Customer Coordination**

* Manage customer interactions from initial enquiry, site visit, property selection, and booking through to sales closure.
* Coordinate with the Sales and Marketing teams to ensure timely follow-ups, booking confirmations, and customer communication.
* Explain project details, unit specifications, floor plans, amenities, payment schedules, pricing structures, and applicable terms to prospective customers within approved company guidelines.
* Coordinate site visits, project presentations, customer meetings, and booking formalities.
* Verify customer details and ensure accurate collection of KYC documents, booking forms, and other preliminary documentation.
* Maintain customer databases, enquiry records, booking status, and follow-up schedules in the CRM system.
* Coordinate with the Sales team on inventory availability, unit blocking, booking status, and customer-specific requirements.
* Ensure a smooth transition of customer information from the pre-sales team to the post-sales CRM team.
* Monitor pending customer actions and proactively resolve coordination gaps that may affect booking conversion.

**B. Post-Sales CRM & Customer Lifecycle Management**

* Independently manage the complete post-sales process from booking confirmation until registration, possession, and post-handover support.
* Act as the primary point of contact for customers after booking and provide timely, accurate updates on their property transactions.
* Coordinate with Sales, Accounts, Legal, Projects, Construction, and Site Operations teams to resolve customer-related matters.
* Maintain customer-wise transaction records, communication logs, payment status, documentation status, and pending activities.
* Ensure all post-sales activities are completed within agreed timelines and in accordance with company policies and applicable regulatory requirements.
* Establish a structured customer communication process for construction progress, payment milestones, registration readiness, and possession schedules.
* Track customer satisfaction, identify recurring issues, and implement corrective measures to improve the overall customer experience.
* Develop and maintain standard operating procedures (SOPs), checklists, and service-level timelines for all CRM activities.

**C. Agreement of Sale & Legal Documentation**

* Prepare, review, coordinate, and track **Agreements of Sale (AoS)**, booking forms, allotment letters, payment schedules, and other customer-related transaction documents in coordination with the Legal team.
* Ensure agreements are prepared using approved templates and accurately reflect customer details, unit specifications, sale consideration, payment terms, and other approved commercial terms.
* Coordinate agreement drafts, customer clarifications, legal review, execution, stamping, and registration-related documentation, as applicable.
* Ensure timely execution of agreements within the defined company timelines.
* Verify and maintain customer KYC documents, PAN, identity and address proofs, company documents for corporate buyers, and other required records.
* Track pending agreements, unsigned documents, incomplete customer files, amendments, cancellations, and other documentation exceptions.
* Coordinate with the Legal team for agreement amendments, addendums, transfer requests, cancellations, refunds, and other contractual matters.
* Maintain secure physical and digital customer files with proper indexing, version control, and audit trails.
* Coordinate with authorized legal professionals and registration teams for sale deed execution and property registration.
* Ensure documentation complies with applicable RERA requirements, Telangana registration procedures, and other relevant legal and statutory requirements.

**D. Payment Follow-Ups & Collections Coordination**

* Coordinate with the Accounts and Finance teams to track customer payments against agreed payment schedules and construction-linked milestones.
* Monitor booking advances, instalments, milestone payments, registration charges, maintenance deposits, and other applicable dues.
* Issue or coordinate payment reminders, demand letters, receipts, and statements of account in accordance with company procedures.
* Maintain customer-wise outstanding reports, ageing reports, overdue payment trackers, and collection follow-up records.
* Proactively follow up with customers regarding overdue payments and escalate delayed or disputed payments to the appropriate management team.
* Reconcile customer ledgers with the Accounts team and resolve discrepancies in payment records.
* Coordinate with Finance on loan disbursements, bank documentation, and home-loan-related customer requirements.
* Support the preparation of periodic reports covering collections, outstanding dues, payment commitments, and collection risks.

**E. Registration, Possession & Handover Management**

* Prepare and maintain registration and possession readiness trackers for all booked units.
* Coordinate with customers, Legal, Finance, site teams, and registration professionals to complete sale deed registration and possession formalities.
* Ensure applicable customer dues and documentation requirements are verified before possession, in accordance with approved company policies and contractual terms.
* Coordinate pre-handover inspections, snag identification, rectification tracking, and customer walkthroughs.
* Ensure handover documents, possession letters, key handover records, meter details, warranty information, and relevant property documents are properly prepared.
* Coordinate with the Projects and Engineering teams to resolve outstanding snags and communicate realistic closure timelines to customers.
* Maintain a unit-wise handover checklist and ensure proper customer acknowledgements and records.
* Coordinate the transfer of relevant information to facility management, maintenance, or property management teams wherever applicable.
* Monitor handover timelines and escalate delays, unresolved defects, or customer concerns to management.

**F. Customer Grievance Management & Relationship Building**

* Handle customer complaints, escalations, service requests, and transaction-related disputes professionally and promptly.
* Establish a structured complaint management process with defined ownership, priority levels, turnaround times, and escalation procedures.
* Coordinate with internal departments to investigate issues, communicate resolutions, and prevent recurrence.
* Manage sensitive customer interactions involving payment disputes, documentation delays, construction updates, possession timelines, and property defects.
* Maintain complaint registers, escalation reports, closure records, and customer feedback.
* Build long-term customer relationships through transparent communication, accountability, and timely service.
* Identify opportunities to improve customer satisfaction, referral generation, and the overall customer experience.

**G. CRM Systems, MIS & Reporting**

* Maintain accurate customer data in the CRM software and ensure regular updates of booking, agreement, payment, registration, and possession statuses.
* Prepare daily, weekly, and monthly MIS reports for management review.
* Track key operational metrics, including:
* Enquiries and booking status coordination.
* Booking-to-agreement turnaround time.
* Agreements pending execution.
* Customer documentation completion.
* Collections and overdue payments.
* Registration and possession readiness.
* Customer complaints and resolution timelines.
* Handover status and outstanding snags.
* Develop dashboards, trackers, and management reports using Excel and CRM tools.
* Maintain data accuracy, confidentiality, document traceability, and timely reporting.
* Recommend process improvements, automation opportunities, and CRM system enhancements.

**H. Team Management & Cross-Functional Coordination**

* Guide and supervise CRM executives and coordinators, where applicable.
* Allocate responsibilities, review pending tasks, and monitor team performance against defined KPIs.
* Establish standardized workflows, checklists, templates, and reporting formats.
* Coordinate regularly with Sales, Marketing, Legal, Finance, Projects, Engineering, and Facility Management teams.
* Conduct periodic reviews of pending customer cases, documentation gaps, payment issues, and handover commitments.
* Ensure clear accountability and timely closure of all customer-related activities.
* Support management in improving CRM processes, service standards, and departmental efficiency.

**3. Required Experience & Qualifications**

* **Experience:** Minimum 8+ years of relevant experience in real estate CRM, with substantial hands-on exposure to both pre-sales coordination and post-sales operations.
* **Industry Background:** Residential apartments, gated communities, luxury villas, plotted developments, and/or commercial real estate.
* Graduate in Business Administration, Commerce, Management, or a related discipline. An MBA or relevant postgraduate qualification will be an added advantage.
* Strong practical experience in Agreements of Sale, customer documentation, payment coordination, registration, and property handover.
* Experience working with real estate developers or reputed property development companies is preferred.
* Prior experience handling premium residential customers, high-value transactions, and customer escalations is desirable.
* Experience managing a CRM team or coordinating across multiple departments will be an added advantage.

**4. Essential Skills & Competencies**

* Strong understanding of the complete real estate sales and post-sales lifecycle.
* Excellent knowledge of Agreement of Sale workflows, booking documentation, registration coordination, and customer file management.
* Strong customer relationship management, negotiation, communication, and problem-solving skills.
* Ability to coordinate effectively with Legal, Finance, Sales, Projects, and Engineering teams.
* Strong command of MS Excel, Word, email communication, MIS reporting, and CRM software.
* Ability to prepare trackers, dashboards, SOPs, and structured management reports.
* Strong follow-up discipline, attention to detail, ownership, and execution capability.
* Ability to manage multiple projects, customer portfolios, and deadlines simultaneously.
* Professional handling of confidential customer information and sensitive commercial matters.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills in English; Telugu and Hindi proficiency will be an advantage.

**5. Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)**

The performance of the Senior CRM professional will be evaluated on the following parameters:

* **Agreement Execution TAT:** Timely preparation, review coordination, and execution of customer agreements.
* **Documentation Accuracy:** Completeness and accuracy of customer files, KYC records, and transaction documents.
* **Payment Follow-Up Efficiency:** Timely follow-up on overdue amounts and accurate reporting of outstanding customer dues.
* **Registration Turnaround:** Timely completion of registration-related coordination, subject to customer, legal, and statutory dependencies.
* **Possession & Handover Efficiency:** Completion of handover formalities within approved project schedules.
* **Customer Satisfaction:** Customer feedback, complaint recurrence, and service quality.
* **Grievance Resolution TAT:** Timely resolution or escalation of customer complaints within defined service levels.
* **CRM Data Accuracy:** Up-to-date customer records, transaction statuses, and reporting accuracy.
* **MIS & Reporting Discipline:** Timely submission of accurate daily, weekly, and monthly reports.
* **Cross-Functional Coordination:** Effective follow-up and closure of customer-related tasks across departments.
* **Team Productivity:** Achievement of assigned targets and adherence to defined CRM processes, wherever team management applies.

**6. Preferred Candidate Profile**

The ideal candidate is a mature, customer-focused, process-oriented professional who can independently manage complex customer transactions and coordinate with multiple internal departments without constant supervision.

The candidate must be equally strong in **customer-facing communication and backend documentation**, particularly Agreements of Sale, payment coordination, registration, and possession management. We are looking for someone who takes ownership, anticipates potential delays, maintains accurate records, and ensures that every customer receives a professional and transparent experience.

Candidates who have worked with established real estate developers and have managed the complete customer lifecycle across apartments, villas, and commercial projects will be preferred.

**7. Application Details**

Interested candidates with relevant real estate CRM experience may share their updated CV, highlighting their experience in pre-sales, post-sales, agreement execution, collections coordination, registration, possession, and customer relationship management.

**Shortlisting Priority:** Candidates with strong hands-on expertise in both pre-sales and post-sales operations, particularly Agreement of Sale documentation and end-to-end customer lifecycle management, will be given preference.

description:

As the leading bank in Asia, DBS Consumer Banking Group is in a unique position to help our customers realise their dreams and ambitions. Our financial solutions are not only the best in the business – they were made just

**Job Purpose**

Lead acquisition, activation, value build-up and retention of high-quality current-account relationships across an assigned cluster. The role owns the cluster’s current-account growth agenda across business segments—including traders, wholesalers, manufacturers, service professionals, institutions and emerging enterprises—while building fee income and cross-sell penetration.

The Cluster Sales Head will lead a team of current-account sales team and relationship managers, work closely with branches and product partners, and ensure the cluster delivers profitable, compliant, transaction-active current-account growth.

**Responsibilities**

**. Cluster Business Ownership**

* Deliver new-to-bank current-account acquisition, account activation, average quarterly balance growth, transaction throughput and fee-income targets for the cluster.
* Build and execute a catchment-led acquisition strategy for high-potential business segments such as wholesalers, distributors, manufacturers, traders, schools, hospitals, clinics, professional firms and service establishments.
* Translate cluster targets into branch-, team- and individual-level productivity plans.
* Own the current-account business plan, sales funnel, conversion pipeline and weekly performance rhythm.
* Improve portfolio quality by prioritising transaction-active, balance-building and cross-sell-ready relationships over dormant or low-value acquisition.

* **Sales Leadership and Channel Execution**

* Lead, coach and motivate a field-sales organisation to consistently deliver acquisition and value-build targets.
* Establish a disciplined sales cadence covering joint calls, market visits, lead reviews, branch huddles, pipeline reviews and conversion tracking.
* Ensure each relationship manager follows a profile-based sales approach rather than a generic product pitch.
* Develop market intelligence on competitor propositions, local business clusters, referral sources and emerging commercial hubs.
* Build productive referral ecosystems with Chartered Accountants, trade associations, market intermediaries, merchant networks, developers, institutional administrators and existing clients.

* **Current-Account Activation and Value Build-Up**

* Ensure newly acquired accounts become transaction-active within defined activation timelines.
* Drive operating balances, inward credits, collections, payment activity and digital banking adoption.
* Track early-warning indicators including low funding, non-activation, declining balances, low transaction velocity and potential attrition.
* Build strategies to migrate primary transaction flows—collections, vendor payments, payroll, taxes and operating cash—to the bank.
* Improve account quality by monitoring average balance, debit transactions, credit transactions and account profitability.

* **Solution-Led Cross-Sell**

* Use the current account as the primary operating hub for business clients and identify the appropriate product solution based on the customer’s business model.
* Drive adoption of corporate internet banking and mobile approvals; cash management and bulk payment solutions; POS, Android POS, QR and Soundbox; sweep-in / sweep-out or FFD structures; debit cards; collections and transaction banking solutions; and promoter, family, wealth and premium savings propositions.
* Partner with product teams to convert business pain points into integrated propositions—for example, POS for collections, Internet Banking for payment controls, FFD for temporary balances and Aspire/premium banking for promoter wallet deepening.

* **Customer Relationship and Service Governance**

* Build senior-level relationships with anchor clients and participate in strategic joint calls for high-value prospects.
* Ensure timely resolution of onboarding, account-opening, transaction, service and digital-banking issues.
* Work with branches and operations teams to reduce turnaround time, improve onboarding quality and strengthen client experience.
* Review top customers and at-risk accounts regularly to protect balances, transactions and wallet share.
* Drive customer retention through proactive engagement, problem solving and relevant product deepening.

* **Risk, Compliance and Portfolio Quality**

* Ensure all sourcing, onboarding and account activation follows internal policies and applicable KYC, AML, fraud-risk and regulatory requirements.
* Maintain high standards of customer due diligence, documentation quality, source-of-funds understanding and business-profile validation.
* Monitor exceptions, unusual transaction behaviour, documentation gaps and operational risks; escalate promptly where needed.
* Build a culture of right-first-time acquisition, with no compromise on compliance for target achievement.

* **People Leadership**

* Recruit, develop, retain and performance-manage a high-quality current-account sales team.
* Set clear scorecards covering acquisition, activation, AQB/AMB, transaction activity, fee income, cross-sell, productivity, service quality and compliance.
* Conduct structured coaching through joint market visits, call observations, weekly reviews and capability-building sessions.
* Identify skill gaps and develop targeted interventions around sales planning, segment understanding, solution selling, digital banking and compliance.
* Maintain a strong talent pipeline and manage attrition proactively.

**Experience**

* 8–15 years of relevant experience in banking, preferably in current accounts, CASA, business banking, SME banking, transaction banking, branch banking or merchant acquiring.
* At least 3–5 years in a people-leadership role managing sales managers, relationship managers or acquisition teams.
* Demonstrated track record of building a current-account portfolio, increasing operating balances and delivering cross-sell revenue.
* Experience in managing business clusters, market catchments, branch ecosystems or multi-location sales teams is preferred.

**Education**

* Graduate degree required.
* MBA / PGDM in Finance, Sales, Marketing or Banking preferred.
* Relevant certifications in banking, KYC/AML, payments or financial products are an advantage.

**Skills and Competencies**

* Strong understanding of current-account economics, CASA, transaction banking, payments, merchant acquiring and business-client needs.

* Solution-selling mindset with ability to connect client pain points to banking products.

* Excellent stakeholder-management skills across branches, products, operations, risk and service.
* High integrity, sound judgement and uncompromising compliance orientation.
* Strong communication, negotiation, coaching and executive-presence skills.

description:

JOB ID: R\-255176 LOCATION: India \- Hyderabad WORK LOCATION TYPE: On Site DATE POSTED: Sep. 17, 2026 CATEGORY: Information Systems
**Manager, Channel Operations – Contracts \& Pricing Execution (AIN)**

**Join Amgen’s Mission of Serving Patients**


At Amgen, if you feel like you’re part of something bigger, it’s because you are. Our shared mission—to serve patients living with serious illnesses—drives all that we do.


Since 1980, we’ve helped pioneer the world of biotech in our fight against the world’s toughest diseases. With our focus on four therapeutic areas –Oncology, Inflammation, General Medicine, and Rare Disease– we reach millions of patients each year. As a member of the Amgen team, you’ll help make a lasting impact on the lives of patients as we research, manufacture, and deliver innovative medicines to help people live longer, fuller happier lives.


Our award\-winning culture is collaborative, innovative, and science based. If you have a passion for challenges and the opportunities that lay within them, you’ll thrive as part of the Amgen team. Join us and transform the lives of patients while transforming your career.

**What you will do**


As the Manager, Channel Operations – Contracts \& Pricing Execution (AIN), you will lead AIN\-based execution of U.S. Channel operations within the Contracts \& Pricing Execution function. This role is responsible for managing Channel Payments, Channel Analytics, contract update processing, CDP maintenance, GCPS administration, scorecard validation, payment package governance, product launch support, operational controls, reconciliations, reporting, documentation, and continuous improvement activities.


Reporting to the Senior Manager/Director, Contracts \& Pricing Execution, you will partner closely with ATO Channel SMEs, National Account Managers, Pricing, Market Access, Trade Operations, Finance, Information Systems, Commercial Operations, and AIN cross\-functional teams to ensure accurate, compliant, scalable, and audit\-ready Channel execution. The role will lead AIN Associates and Analysts to support Channel operations while preserving appropriate ATO oversight for strategic decisions, complex contract interpretation, customer\-facing engagement, approvals, and risk management.

**Key Responsibilities**

*Channel Operations Leadership*

* Lead end\-to\-end execution of Channel operations including contract update processing, CDP management, GCPS administration, scorecard generation, payment processing, waiver governance, analytics support, reconciliations, and payment package readiness.
* Manage workloads, operational calendars, payment cycles, quarter\-close deliverables, issue inventories, exception management, and execution readiness across Channel processes.
* Ensure repeatable and scalable execution of standard\-state activities transitioning to AIN while maintaining proper escalation pathways for complex decisions and approval requirements.
* Establish operational discipline through KPI management, workload balancing, service expectations, quality reviews, readiness gates, and issue escalation frameworks.

*CDP, Contract \& GCPS Governance*

* Oversee Monthly and Quarterly CDP Update processes, Conga review activities, contract amendment assessments, and operational implementation of approved contract changes.
* Lead GCPS setup, maintenance, strategy updates, tracker governance, and program configuration activities.
* Ensure CDP\-to\-GCPS alignment, execution quality, peer\-review effectiveness, and appropriate documentation retention.
* Partner with NAMs and retained ATO stakeholders on contract interpretation, amendment impact assessments, and complex operational decisions.

*Payments, Validation \& Financial Controls*

* Oversee scorecard generation, DOH validation, net sales reconciliation, payment package readiness, waiver processing, and payment calculation activities.
* Lead review of performance reports, scorecards, payment packages, trend reporting, and reconciliation outputs.
* Ensure SOX\-aligned controls, documentation standards, review evidence, decision logs, and audit readiness requirements are consistently maintained.
* Drive operational governance across payment approvals, exception resolution, reconciliation reviews, and control execution.

*Analytics, Reporting \& Operational Insights*

* Lead Channel analytics support including net sales reconciliations, inventory reporting, compliance reporting, DOH analysis, 852/867 validation activities, and operational dashboards.
* Review variances, trends, recurring exceptions, payment drivers, and operational metrics to improve execution quality and transparency.
* Ensure reporting outputs support decision\-making, payment approvals, audit requirements, and operational planning activities.
* Drive reporting standardization, KPI adoption, and analytics maturity across the Channel organization.

*Product Launch \& Continuous Improvement*

* Oversee AIN execution support for product launch readiness, MMDS activities, approved WAC maintenance activities, master data coordination, and launch documentation governance.
* Partner with ATO launch SMEs on transition planning, launch support activities, SOX documentation requirements, and process readiness.
* Drive automation, simplification, AI\-enabled opportunities, reporting improvements, issue reduction initiatives, and workflow optimization.
* Support system enhancements, UAT execution, defect management, access readiness, and digital transformation initiatives across Channel operations.

*People Leadership \& Transition Readiness*

* Lead, coach, and develop AIN\-based Medicaid Associates / Senior Associates supporting Medicaid operations and transition execution.
* Build a structured onboarding and KT model across learning, shadowing, reverse shadowing, supervised execution, and readiness sign\-off before independent ownership expands.
* Partner with ATO Medicaid SMEs to define skills, proficiency levels, QA standards, escalation rules, and readiness criteria for each Medicaid process step.
* Create a culture of accountability, compliance, quality, continuous improvement, stakeholder service, and One CPE collaboration across ATO and AIN.

*Compliance, Controls \& Audit Readiness*

* Ensure compliance with SOX controls, internal policies, pricing governance requirements, audit standards, and applicable pharmaceutical contracting regulations
* Maintain audit\-ready documentation, approval evidence, decision logs, dispute records, and process workpapers supporting operational compliance.
* Identify operational, compliance, financial, and data integrity risks and lead mitigation and remediation efforts.
* Support internal, external, and SOX audit activities and drive closure of audit observations.

**What We Expect of You**


We are all different, yet we all use our unique contributions to serve patients. The ideal candidate is a strong Medicaid / managed markets operations leader with experience in U.S. healthcare or pharmaceutical rebate operations, financial controls, systems enablement, and people leadership. This individual combines operational discipline, Medicaid domain knowledge, analytical rigor, stakeholder collaboration, and a continuous improvement mindset to build a scalable AIN Medicaid capability.

**Basic Qualifications**

* Master's degree in Finance, Accounting, Commerce, Business Administration, Economics, Life Sciences, Pharmacy, Engineering, Analytics, or related discipline.
* 8 to 13 years of progressive experience in pharmaceutical, biotech, Gross\-to\-Net, Channel operations, revenue management, contract operations, commercial finance, analytics, or related areas.
* 3\+ years of experience leading people, operational teams, or complex cross\-functional delivery.
* Experience partnering with U.S.\-based stakeholders across Finance, Market Access, Pricing, Contracting, Commercial Operations, Compliance, IT, or Revenue Management organizations.
* Experience leading process execution, reporting, controls, documentation, reconciliations, or operational transformation initiative

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Deep understanding of Channel Payments, distributor agreements, fees and rebates, inventory management rebates, DOH methodologies, scorecards, net sales reconciliations, payment package governance, and Gross\-to\-Net operations.
* Experience with Model N GCPS, SAP, Conga, IntegriChain, Tableau, Qlik, Power BI, Power Query, Alteryx, SharePoint, and automation technologies.
* Experience supporting SOX controls, operational audits, access governance, issue management, UAT activities, and system enhancements.
* Demonstrated success leading transitions, KT programs, process standardization, automation, reporting modernization, and continuous improvement initiatives.
* Strong stakeholder management, executive\-ready communication, people leadership, analytical, and change\-management skills.

title: Retail Cluster Manager
description:
**About Optorium**

Optorium is Hyderabad's leading destination for luxury and premium eyewear, established in 2004 with 5 boutique stores across Banjara Hills, Gachibowli, Secunderabad, and Kukatpally. We carry the world's most prestigious eyewear brands including Gucci, Prada, Tom Ford, Ray\-Ban, Burberry, and more.

We are at an exciting growth inflection point — strong walk\-in traffic, an established brand, and a loyal customer base. We now need a driven, commercially sharp leader to take ownership of business development and marketing strategy across all four branches and deliver aggressive year\-on\-year sales growth.

"This is a P\&L accountability role. The Cluster Head owns the number — revenue targets, YoY growth, marketing ROI, and customer acquisition — across all four Optorium branches in Hyderabad."

**Role Overview**

The Cluster Head will be the senior commercial leader across Optorium's Hyderabad cluster, responsible for driving revenue growth, building and executing the marketing strategy across online and offline channels, and building the brand's dominance in the local luxury eyewear market. This person will set sales targets for each branch, monitor performance daily, lead BTL and ATL campaigns, drive digital growth, and develop new business opportunities — from corporate tie\-ups to brand events and influencer activations.

This is a high\-autonomy, high\-accountability role. You will have direct access to the founders, a budget to execute your plans, and a clear incentive structure that rewards overperformance generously.

**Key Responsibilities**

**1\. Business Development \& Revenue Growth**

* Own the monthly and annual revenue target for all four branches — set branch\-wise sales goals in alignment with overall Optorium business targets
* Identify and develop new revenue streams — corporate gifting programmes, B2B tie\-ups with hospitals, clinics, corporates, hotels, and high\-net\-worth individual networks
* Build and manage relationships with key accounts — concierge services, premium corporate HR departments, and referral partners
* Track competitor activity (Dayal Opticals, Gem Opticians, Specsmakers) and identify market gaps or opportunities for Optorium to exploit
* Develop a structured customer retention programme — loyalty offers, repeat purchase incentives, and premium member benefits
* Identify and evaluate potential new branch locations or pop\-up opportunities for future expansion
* Prepare and present a monthly business development report to the founders with pipeline, deals, and revenue impact

**2\. Sales Target Setting, Monitoring \& Incentive Management**

* Set monthly and quarterly sales targets for each branch and each sales staff member — broken down by brand, category (frames, sunglasses, lenses), and ticket size
* Monitor daily sales performance across branches using POS data and report variances against target with corrective actions
* Design and run monthly branch\-level sales incentive schemes — aligned to the company's monthly \+ annual variable incentive structure
* Conduct weekly sales review calls with branch managers and a monthly in\-person performance review at each branch
* Build a YoY growth dashboard tracking revenue, footfall, conversion rate, average ticket size, and repeat customer ratio per branch
* Identify underperforming branches early and implement focused turnaround plans within 30 days

**3\. Marketing Strategy — Online \& Offline**

* Own the integrated marketing strategy for Optorium across all channels — digital, in\-store, events, PR, and paid media
* Work in close coordination with the Content \& Digital Marketing Executive to ensure all content, SEO, and social media output is aligned to business goals and seasonal campaigns
* Plan and execute a quarterly marketing calendar — aligned to brand launches, festive seasons (Diwali, New Year, Valentine's Day, Summer), and new collection drops
* Manage and optimise the Google Ads and Meta Ads budgets — set target CPL (cost per lead), ROAS (return on ad spend), and walk\-in attribution goals
* Develop Optorium's online presence strategy to build national visibility alongside the dominant Hyderabad local ranking
* Track and report marketing ROI monthly — spend vs. footfall lift, revenue attributed to campaigns, and channel\-wise performance

**4\. BTL (Below the Line) Marketing**

* Plan and execute hyperlocal BTL activations — in\-mall promotions, residential society events, corporate campus drives, and premium apartment complex tie\-ups near each branch
* Organise in\-store brand events — exclusive preview nights, brand ambassador visits, new collection launches, and VIP customer evenings
* Manage the annual in\-store visual merchandising refresh — window displays, POP materials, and brand\-specific display zones aligned to seasonal campaigns
* Coordinate with brand principals (Luxottica, Safilo, etc.) to access co\-branded BTL budgets and promotional materials
* Execute referral and word\-of\-mouth programmes — structured incentives for existing customers who bring new buyers
* Build a database of Hyderabad's premium residential catchments near each branch and execute targeted door\-drop or WhatsApp campaigns

**5\. ATL (Above the Line) Marketing**

* Plan and manage ATL campaigns — OOH (outdoor hoardings near each branch), radio spots on Hyderabad's premium stations, and print in curated luxury lifestyle publications
* Develop seasonal ATL campaigns for key moments — summer sunglass season, festive gifting, and New Year refresh
* Brief and manage creative agencies for campaign concept, design, and production
* Negotiate media buying — hoarding placements, radio slots, and magazine insertions — at optimal rates
* Track ATL campaign impact through footfall data, brand search volume lift, and customer\-reported discovery source

**6\. Digital \& Online Channel Growth**

* Drive Optorium's e\-commerce revenue growth through optorium.in — set monthly online sales targets and work with the digital team to optimise conversion
* Develop and execute a performance marketing strategy — Google Shopping ads, Search ads, Meta retargeting — to drive both online sales and store walk\-ins
* Oversee Optorium's local SEO strategy in coordination with the content team — targeting top\-3 Google rankings for all major brand \+ Hyderabad keyword combinations
* Build and manage influencer marketing strategy — identify, brief, and coordinate Hyderabad\-based luxury lifestyle micro and macro influencers
* Develop a WhatsApp Business strategy for customer segmentation and targeted new collection communications

**7\. Team Leadership \& Branch Management Support**

* Lead, mentor, and motivate branch managers and sales teams across all four locations
* Set clear performance expectations for each branch team and conduct quarterly performance reviews in coordination with the HR Executive
* Identify skill gaps in the sales team and plan product knowledge and upselling training sessions — minimum once per quarter
* Ensure consistent premium customer experience standards across all four branches through regular floor visits and mystery shopping
* Collaborate with the HR Executive on hiring plans to ensure branches are fully staffed ahead of peak seasons

**Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)**

BTL activations — minimum one per branch per quarter Top 3Google ranking for all major brand \+ Hyderabad keywords\<3%Marketing spend as % of total cluster revenue2–3New B2B / corporate accounts opened per quarter

**Skills \& Requirements**

**Must\-have**

* 5 years of experience in retail business development, area/cluster management, or marketing — luxury, lifestyle, or premium consumer goods preferred
* Proven track record of owning and delivering revenue targets across multiple locations
* Hands\-on experience planning and executing BTL and ATL campaigns end to end
* Strong understanding of digital marketing — Google Ads, Meta Ads, SEO, and performance marketing metrics
* Excellent commercial acumen — comfortable reading P\&L, footfall data, and conversion metrics
* Strong leadership skills — able to motivate, coach, and hold accountable a multi\-branch sales team
* Excellent communication in English and Telugu/Hindi — able to present confidently to founders and brand partners
* Highly organised and data\-driven — uses dashboards and reports to lead decisions, not gut alone

**Nice to have**

* Prior experience in optical, eyewear, watches, jewellery, fashion accessories, or luxury retail

title: Senior Business Development Manager
description:
**Company:** PMJ Jewels

**Location:** Somajiguda,Hyderabad

**Department:** Sales \& Business Development

**Employment Type:** Full\-time

**Role Overview**

We are seeking a driven and customer\-centric **In\-Store Business Development Executive** to spearhead the promotion and enrollment of the **Golden Peacock Jewellery Purchase Plan**. In this role, you will be the primary point of contact for walk\-in customers, educating them on the financial benefits of our 11\-month advance payment scheme. Your goal is to maximize plan subscriptions, build long\-term customer relationships, and drive future gold and diamond sales through the program.

**Key Responsibilities**

**1\. Customer Engagement \& Pitching**

* Actively approach and engage with walk\-in customers on the showroom floor to introduce the Golden Peacock Jewellery Purchase Plan.
* Clearly articulate the plan's benefits, terms, maturity periods, and loyalty rewards (e.g., the 1\-month loyalty reward upon completion of 11 installments).
* Consult with customers to understand their upcoming milestones (weddings, anniversaries) and tailor the pitch to show how the plan makes purchasing exquisite jewellery more accessible.

**2\. Sales \& Target Achievement**

* Meet and exceed monthly and quarterly enrollment targets for the purchase plan.
* Convert casual walk\-ins and one\-time buyers into loyal, long\-term subscribers by highlighting the exclusive discounts and zero\-wastage benefits (if applicable).
* Guide customers to appropriate monthly subscription tiers (e.g., minimum commitments to premium brackets) based on their budget and future jewellery requirements.

**3\. Relationship Management \& Follow\-up**

* Maintain a detailed CRM database of leads, existing subscribers, and prospective clients.
* Conduct regular, polite follow\-ups via phone or messaging for monthly payment reminders, maturity notifications, and early redemption queries.
* Ensure a seamless redemption experience when the plan matures after 330 days, personally assisting customers on the floor with their final jewellery purchases.

**4\. Operations \& Compliance**

* Assist customers with the enrollment documentation, ensuring strict KYC compliance (collection of valid photo IDs, address proofs, and PAN cards for larger amounts).
* Manage the issuance of digital or physical Passbooks and ensure accurate payment receipts are generated for cash, card, or ACH transactions.
* Coordinate with the store manager and accounts team to resolve any payment discrepancies, missed installments, or plan transfers.

**Qualifications \& Skills**

* **Experience:** 2–4 years of experience in retail sales, business development, or financial product sales. (Experience in the jewellery sector, chit funds, or banking/insurance is highly preferred).
* **Education:** Bachelor’s degree in Business, Marketing, or a related field.
* **Communication:** Exceptional verbal communication skills in English and the regional language.
* **Core Competencies:** Strong persuasive abilities, customer empathy, relationship\-building skills, and a target\-driven mindset.
* **Tech\-Savvy:** Comfortable using CRM software, point\-of\-sale (POS) systems, and basic MS Office applications.

Pay: ₹25,000\.00 \- ₹45,000\.00 per month

* Cell phone reimbursement
* Flexible schedule

title: Sr. Manager / Manager- Spare Parts & Services Sales
description:
**We are a global technology company developing innovative solutions for mining, tunnelling, and construction, improving project safety, environmental impact, and productivity. We offer premium equipment, all\-round aftermarket services and high\-quality chemicals and rock support as our core products to our customers. We operate globally in over 30 countries with more than 1,800 experts. At Normet, we commit to a culture founded in our Values \- Caring, Committed \& Courageous. We foster your talent, with us you shine.**

**Parts \& Service Sales Manager / Sr. Manager – Mining \& Tunnelling Equipment**

**Experience: 15\+ Years**  

**Industry: Mining, Tunnelling, Construction \& Underground Equipment**  

**Function: Aftermarket / Parts \& Service Sales**

**Location; Hyderabad**

**1\. Job Purpose**

The Parts \& Service Sales Manager will be responsible for driving the growth and profitability of the **aftermarket Parts and Service business** for mining and tunnelling equipment.


The position will lead customer relationships, aftermarket sales, service contracts, spare parts business, equipment lifecycle support, rental, and business development while ensuring high customer satisfaction and strong commercial performance.


The role requires a strong understanding of **underground mining, tunnelling equipment, spare parts, maintenance, field service, equipment uptime and customer operations** .


**2\. Key Responsibilities**

**A. Safety Culture – Key Expectations**

* Demonstrate Safety First leadership in all customer, site and internal activities.
* Promote a zero\-harm mindset across Parts, Service, Rental and Rebuild operations.
* Ensure all field activities comply with company HSE policies, customer site safety requirements and applicable statutory regulations.
* Never compromise safety for sales targets, delivery timelines, machine uptime or commercial pressure.
* Ensure service engineers and technicians are properly trained, competent and equipped with required PPE and safety tools.
* Conduct and participate in toolbox talks, risk assessments, JSA/JHA and site safety reviews.
* Identify unsafe conditions and ensure corrective actions are implemented promptly.
* Encourage employees and contractors to Stop Work when an unsafe situation is identified.
* Promote reporting of near misses, incidents and unsafe acts without creating a blame culture.
* Ensure safe working practices during machine maintenance, troubleshooting, component replacement, rebuilds and commissioning.
* Work closely with customers to improve machine safety, operator safety and equipment reliability.
* Include safety performance as an important part of team and individual KPIs.
* Lead by example and demonstrate visible safety leadership during mine and tunnelling site visits

**B. Parts \& Aftermarket Sales**

* Develop and achieve annual **Parts and Service sales targets** .
* Drive growth of genuine spare parts, consumables, wear parts and maintenance kits.
* Develop aftermarket business opportunities from the installed equipment base.
* Analyse equipment population, parts consumption and customer maintenance requirements to identify business opportunities.
* Develop strategies to increase **customer retention and share of wallet** .
* Manage pricing, quotations, negotiations and commercial proposals.
* Monitor competitor activities, pricing and market trends.

**C. Service Business Development**

* Develop and sell **annual maintenance contracts (AMC), service contracts, rental/service packages and preventive maintenance programs** .
* Identify opportunities for equipment rebuilds, overhauls, refurbishment and life\-extension programs.
* Develop service solutions focused on reducing customer downtime and improving equipment availability.
* Coordinate with the service team for manpower planning, site deployment and contract execution.
* Ensure timely renewal and expansion of existing service contracts.

**D. Rebuild, Refurbishment \& Lifecycle Business**

* Develop a structured **equipment rebuild and refurbishment business** .
* Identify ageing equipment with potential for life extension.
* Develop rebuild proposals based on machine condition, operating hours and customer requirements.
* Promote component exchange, rebuild, refurbishment and upgrade solutions.
* Work with Technical/Service teams to develop scope of work and cost estimates.
* Build a pipeline of major repair, overhaul and rebuild opportunities.
* Develop customer ROI/TCO proposals demonstrating the benefit of rebuild versus new equipment.

**E. Rental \& Used Equipment Solutions**

* Develop the UG\&I rental business for customers requiring short\- and medium\-term equipment solutions.
* Identify suitable machines and applications for rental.
* Develop rental packages including service, maintenance and parts support.
* Evaluate rental versus purchase/rebuild opportunities from the customer's perspective.
* Establish commercial controls covering utilisation, downtime, damage, maintenance and recovery.
* Develop lifecycle strategies for rental fleet equipment.

**F. Customer \& Market Development**

* Build strong relationships with mining companies, tunnelling contractors, EPC companies, infrastructure companies and equipment fleet owners.
* Develop relationships with key decision\-makers including **Procurement, Maintenance, Projects, Mines, Engineering and Operations teams** .
* Conduct regular customer visits and understand equipment utilisation, maintenance practices and future requirements.
* Identify new customers, projects and mining/tunnelling opportunities.
* Develop strategic account plans for major customers.
* Collect and communicate market intelligence, competitor information and customer feedback.

**G. Installed Base \& Fleet Management**

* Maintain and develop an accurate **installed\-base / equipment population database** .
* Track machine age, operating hours, maintenance history, parts consumption and service requirements.
* Develop machine\-specific aftermarket plans.
* Identify potential opportunities for major component replacement, rebuilds and upgrades.
* Promote preventive maintenance and genuine parts to improve equipment reliability.

**H. Commercial \& Business Management**

* Prepare annual Parts \& Service business plans and budgets.
* Manage sales pipeline, forecasting and order booking.
* Monitor gross margins, pricing and profitability.

description:
Job Description

**Accountant Manager \& Administration Executive** 

We are looking for an experienced and responsible **Accountant Manager \& Administration Executive** to manage day\-to\-day accounting, taxation, banking, documentation, and administrative activities of the company.

The ideal candidate should have strong practical knowledge of **Tally ERP, GST, TDS, Income Tax, MS Excel, banking operations, and statutory compliance**. The candidate should be capable of independently handling accounting records, tax filings, financial reports, and official documentation.

An **MBA (Finance/Accounting)** or relevant professional qualification will be an added advantage.

Key Responsibilities1\. Accounting \& Finance

* Maintain day\-to\-day accounts and books of accounts in **Tally ERP**.
* Record sales, purchases, receipts, payments, journal entries, and expenses.
* Maintain customer, vendor, and general ledgers.
* Manage **Accounts Payable and Accounts Receivable**.
* Prepare and maintain **Bank Reconciliation Statements (BRS)**.
* Prepare monthly and yearly financial reports.
* Monitor company expenses, cash flow, outstanding payments, and collections.
* Coordinate with auditors and provide required accounting records and documents.

2\. GST \& Taxation

* Prepare and file **GST returns**, including GSTR\-1 and GSTR\-3B.
* Reconcile purchase and sales data with GST records.
* Ensure timely GST compliance and maintain proper supporting documents.
* Handle GST notices, assessments, audits, and departmental correspondence.
* Maintain records required for GST and other statutory compliance.
* Assist in **Income Tax and TDS compliance**.

3\. TDS

* Calculate and deduct **TDS** as applicable.
* Prepare and file periodic TDS returns.
* Verify TDS deductions on vendor and other applicable payments.
* Maintain TDS records, challans, certificates, and related documentation.
* Reconcile TDS accounts and resolve discrepancies.

4\. Banking Operations

* Coordinate with banks for routine banking activities.
* Prepare and process **NEFT, RTGS, IMPS, and cheque payments**.
* Maintain bank statements and perform regular reconciliation.
* Monitor bank balances and company transactions.
* Handle banking documentation and account\-related formalities.
* Assist with loan documentation and other banking requirements.

5\. Legal \& Business Documentation

* Prepare and maintain **work orders, agreements, contracts, service orders, declarations, affidavits, and official documents**.
* Draft professional business letters, notices, and correspondence.
* Maintain statutory and company documentation.
* Coordinate with legal consultants, auditors, and government authorities when required.

6\. Administration

* Handle day\-to\-day administrative and office coordination activities.
* Maintain proper filing and documentation systems.
* Coordinate with clients, vendors, banks, auditors, consultants, and government departments.
* Prepare internal reports and official communications.
* Support management with administrative and financial requirements.

7\. MIS \& Management Reporting

* Prepare regular **MIS reports** for management.
* Provide information on sales, purchases, expenses, receivables, payables, cash flow, and outstanding payments.
* Assist management in budgeting, forecasting, and cost control.
* Identify accounting discrepancies and provide timely solutions.

Required Qualifications

* **MBA (Finance)** or equivalent qualification.
* **2–5 years of relevant experience** in accounting and taxation.
* Strong practical knowledge of:
* **Tally ERP / Tally Prime**
* **GST**
* **TDS**
* **Income Tax**
* **MS Excel**
* Bank Reconciliation
* Accounts Payable \& Receivable
* Statutory Compliance

Desired Skills

* Strong knowledge of accounting principles and financial processes.
* Good working knowledge of **GST and TDS compliance**.
* Good proficiency in **Tally and MS Excel**.
* Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills.
* High attention to detail and accuracy.
* Good written and verbal communication skills.
* Ability to independently manage multiple responsibilities.
* Good organizational and time\-management skills.
* Professional attitude and ability to maintain confidentiality.
* Experience in business/legal documentation will be an advantage.

Experience

**2–5 years** of relevant experience in:

* Accounting \& Bookkeeping
* Tally ERP/Tally Prime
* GST \& TDS
* Income Tax Compliance
* Banking Operations
* MIS Reporting
* Administration \& Documentation

Employment Type

The ideal candidate should be able to **independently handle the company's day\-to\-day accounting, GST, TDS, banking, documentation, and administrative activities** with minimum supervision.

Excellent verbal and written communication skills (English/ local language) to effectively convey value propositions and build relationships with potential clients. Knowledge on compressors, chillers, refrigeration mandatory and experience with Indian Navy procurement departments preferred.

We offer an exciting and challenging position. Joining us you will become part of a leading global multi\-industrial corporation defined by its stimulating work environment and job satisfaction.
